articles.summary: DART low-dose dexamethasone — для high-BPD-risk preterm vent-dependent > 7-10 d. AAP COFN 2010 framework: ≥ 50 % BPD chance.
articles.content:
## История controversial

1990s-2000s: routine high-dose dexamethasone — dramatic ↓ BPD, но ↑ cerebral palsy + cognitive impairment (Yeh 1998 NEJM, Doyle 2014 review). Practice swung к conservative.

2010+ era: **AAP COFN framework 2010** — selective targeted use в highest-risk infants. **DART trial 2006** — low-dose, short-duration safer alternative.

## AAP COFN 2010 framework

Dexamethasone reasonable если:
- Preterm < 28 нед
- На MV ≥ 7-14 d
- Estimated BPD chance ≥ 50 % (используя prediction tools)
- Discuss benefits/risks с family

## Schemes

### DART (Doyle 2006 NEJM, Pediatrics 2014)
**Low-dose schedule (preferred):**
- Day 1-3: 0.075 мг/кг q12h IV (0.15 мг/кг/d)
- Day 4-6: 0.05 мг/кг q12h (0.10 мг/кг/d)
- Day 7-8: 0.025 мг/кг q12h (0.05 мг/кг/d)
- Day 9-10: 0.025 мг/кг q24h (0.025 мг/кг/d)
- **Total dose:** 0.89 мг/кг over 10 days

### High-dose (HISTORICAL — НЕ recommended)
- Hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q6h × 12 d, then taper
- DEX 0.25 мг/кг q12h × 3 d, then taper × 21 d (старый Yeh protocol)

## Hydrocortisone (alternative — controversial)

### PREMILOC 2016 (Baud O, Lancet 387:1827)
- 0.5 мг/кг q12h × 7 d → 0.25 мг/кг q12h × 3 d (low-dose)
- Started early (24-48 h life)
- ↓ BPD modest (6 % difference)
- ↑ Late-onset sepsis у some

### Watterberg 2007 (Pediatrics 120:40)
- Hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q12h
- Не показал survival benefit

## Inhaled steroids — separate evidence

### Budesonide (Bassler NEUROSIS 2015 NEJM)
- 400 мкг inhaled q12h × first month + repeat q6 нед
- ↓ BPD (relative reduction ~10 %)
- НО ↑ mortality (concerning) — controversial

### Yeh 2016 (NEJM 374:2229) — intratracheal
- 0.25 мг/кг intra-tracheal mixed с surfactant
- Effective ↓ BPD у extreme preterm

## Adverse effects

### Acute (during treatment)
- Hyperglycemia
- Hypertension
- GI bleeding (rare у low-dose)
- Adrenal suppression — taper required
- Growth failure
- Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (rare у low-dose)

### Late (long-term concerns)
- Cerebral palsy (high-dose era — ↑ 60 % увеличение risk)
- Cognitive impairment (high-dose)
- ↓ Brain growth (head circumference)
- ↓ Linear growth

**DART low-dose evidence:** acceptable safety profile при targeted use.

## Decision tools

Use BPD prediction calculators (NICHD calculator) — estimate individual risk.

If BPD risk:
- < 35 %: avoid steroids (risks > benefits)
- 35-50 %: individualize
- ≥ 50 %: discuss with family
- ≥ 65 %: steroids likely beneficial

## Calculator Bordik

- neo-bpd-nih (BPD severity)
- neo-dexamethasone-dose (DART scheme)
- neo-budesonide-dose (Yeh / NEUROSIS)
- neo-hydrocortisone-dose (PREMILOC)

articles.title_ru: ECMO у новорождённых — критерии и practice
articles.summary: OI > 40 + потенциально reversible disease. GA ≥ 34 нед, BW ≥ 2 кг. VA ECMO для PPHN/CDH. VV для primary respiratory failure без cardiac.
articles.content:
## Показания (ELSO 2023 guidelines)

### Включающие
- **OI > 40** для 4 ч (сохраняется despite optimal therapy + iNO)
- **OI > 25** для 8 ч в severe MAS / CDH
- **PaO₂ < 40 мм рт ст** > 2 ч
- **pH < 7.15** + lactate > 5 ммоль/л > 2 ч (cardiogenic shock)
- **Failure of pharmacologic therapy** (iNO, sildenafil, milrinone)

### Включающие критерии: gestational + size
- GA ≥ 34 нед
- BW ≥ 2 кг
- Возраст ≤ 14 d (relative — некоторые центры до 28 d)

### Исключающие
- Lethal congenital anomaly
- Severe IVH grade III-IV
- Coagulopathy uncontrollable
- Trisomy 13/18
- Severe brain injury
- > 14 d MV (irreversible lung disease likely)
- Active uncontrolled bleeding

## Типы ECMO

### VA (veno-arterial)
- Both circulatory + respiratory support
- Cannulation: внутренняя ярёмная вена → правое предсердие (drain); правая common carotid artery (return)
- **Preferred для:** PPHN, MAS severe, CDH, sepsis с cardiogenic shock

### VV (veno-venous)
- Только respiratory support (cardiac function preserved)
- Cannulation: dual-lumen IJ catheter (Avalon)
- **Preferred для:** primary respiratory failure без cardiac dysfunction
- Преimущества: preserve carotid (no ligation); higher long-term neuro outcomes

## Cannulation практика

- Под general anesthesia
- Cardiac surgeon involvement preferred
- Heparin loading 100 ед/кг IV pre-cannulation
- ACT goal 180-220 sec на ECMO (некоторые centers 160-180)

## Management на ECMO

### Anticoagulation
- Heparin continuous infusion 20-50 ед/кг/h
- Monitoring: ACT q4h, PTT q12h, anti-Xa weekly
- Bivalirudin alternative при HIT (rare у н/р)

### Ventilation "rest" settings
- PEEP 8-10 см H₂O
- PIP < 25 см H₂O
- Rate 10-20/min
- FiO₂ 0.21-0.30 (lung rest)
- Gentle ventilation prevents barotrauma — recovery

### Sedation + paralysis
- Continuous fentanyl + midazolam
- Paralysis (vecuronium / cisatracurium) для extreme labile

### Monitoring
- Daily heads UZI (IVH detection)
- Continuous SaO₂ pre/post-oxygenator
- Лабораторно q4-6h: ABG, electrolytes, ACT, lactate
- Daily echo (cardiac function recovery)

## Complications

### Bleeding (most common)
- Intracranial 10-20 %
- Cannula site
- GI

### Cannula-related
- Vascular injury (аорта, IJ vein)
- Airway compression (rare, large cannulas)

### Stroke / IVH
- 15-20 % survivors
- Higher у VA (carotid ligation)

### Сепсис
- Cannula-related bloodstream infection
- Antifungal prophylaxis (fluconazole) some centers

## Outcomes (ELSO Registry)

| Cause | Survival к discharge |
|---|---|
| **MAS** | 95 % |
| **PPHN (idiopathic)** | 85 % |
| **Sepsis** | 75 % |
| **CDH** | 50-60 % |
| **Cardiac post-op** | 40-50 % |

**Long-term ND outcomes:** 25-50 % survivors имеют neurodevelopmental impairment (cognitive, motor, hearing).

## ELSO 2023 updates

- Routine cardiac MRI before decannulation
- Anti-Xa target 0.3-0.7 (instead of just ACT)
- Bivalirudin для HIT/heparin sensitivity
- VV preferred when cardiac function permits (long-term carotid preservation)

## Калькуляторы Bordik
- neo-resp-indices (OI/OSI calculation — gateway к ECMO criteria)
- neo-ino-dose (pre-ECMO trial)
- neo-sildenafil-dose

- Cochrane Neonatal ECMO 2008:CD001340 — meta-analysis
- Smartt LF et al. **Pediatr Crit Care Med 2024;25:e218** — VV vs VA neonatal

articles.summary: Antenatal Dx → стабилизация перед surgery. Gentle ventilation, permissive hypercapnia. iNO + ECMO при PPHN. Repair после стабилизации.
articles.content:
## Определение

CDH — porок развития диафрагмы с migration abdominal organs в thoracic cavity, ведущим к pulmonary hypoplasia + persistent pulmonary hypertension of newborn (PPHN).

## Epidemiology

- 1 / 2500-3000 livebirths
- Left-sided 80-85 % (Bochdalek hernia)
- Right-sided 10-15 %
- Bilateral 1-2 % (lethal)

## Pathophysiology

1. Failure pleuroperitoneal canal закрытия (8-12 нед gestation)
2. Abdominal viscera (intestines, stomach, spleen, sometimes liver) → thorax
3. Compression developing lungs → pulmonary hypoplasia (BOTH sides — contralateral эффект)
4. Aberrant pulmonary vascular development → PPHN
5. Cardiac displacement (mediastinum shift)

## Antenatal management

### Diagnosis
- Routine 18-20 нед anatomy УЗИ
- Visualization stomach в chest, mediastinal shift
- Confirmation: fetal MRI
- LHR (Lung-to-Head Ratio) — predictor severity
  - LHR < 1.0: severe (mortality > 70 %)
  - LHR 1.0-1.4: moderate
  - LHR > 1.4: mild
- O/E LHR (observed/expected) — refined predictor

### Antenatal interventions
- **FETO (Fetal Endoscopic Tracheal Occlusion)** — TOTAL trial 2021 NEJM
  - Severe CDH: ↑ survival (40 % vs 15 %)
  - Risk preterm birth
- **Counseling** — multidisciplinary (perinatology, neonatology, surgery)
- **Delivery в специализированном center** с ECMO availability

## Postnatal management — "gentle approach"

### Резonimация в родзале
1. **Avoid bag-mask ventilation** — gas в stomach worsens compression
2. **Immediate intubation** — orotracheal
3. **OG decompression** large bore (10-12 Fr)
4. **Pre-ductal SpO₂** monitoring
5. **Avoid manual hyperventilation**

### NICU stabilization (gentle ventilation)
- **Permissive hypercapnia** PaCO₂ 50-60 (pH > 7.25)
- **Permissive hypoxemia** SpO₂ 85-95 % pre-ductal
- **PIP < 25** (high baromtrauma risk у hypoplastic lungs)
- **HFOV** при failure conventional
- Sedation + paralysis if necessary
- Surfactant — controversial, limited benefit (NOT routine)

### PPHN management
- iNO 20 ppm (controversial — NEONIH 2019 показал no benefit у CDH specifically)
- Sildenafil PO 0.5-2 мг/кг q6h
- Milrinone 0.25-0.75 мкг/кг/мин
- ECMO criteria — OI > 40 sustained

### Stabilization criteria до surgery
- pH > 7.25
- PaO₂ pre-ductal > 60 мм рт ст
- Lactate < 4 ммоль/л
- MAP > 50
- iNO weaning или off
- Stable vasopressor support
- Off ECMO ideally (some centers operate on ECMO)

## Surgical repair

### Timing
- **Delayed repair** (после стабилизации, 24-72 ч typically) — preferred
- **Old practice (immediate repair)** — abandoned: high mortality

### Approach
- **Open thoracotomy** — standard
- **Open laparotomy** — alternative
- **Thoracoscopic / minimally invasive** — emerging (selected stable patients, CO₂ insufflation tolerance)

### Repair technique
- **Primary repair** (small defects ~30 %)
- **Patch repair** (large defects ~70 %): Gore-Tex / Surgisis / autologous muscle flap
- Closure stomach ± spleen / left lobe liver reduced into abdomen

## Outcomes (CDH Study Group registry)

| Severity | Survival к discharge |
|---|---|
| **Mild** | 90 % |
| **Moderate** | 70-80 % |
| **Severe** | 30-50 % |
| **Severe + ECMO** | 50-65 % |

### Long-term morbidity
- BPD (chronic O₂ dependence) 20-50 %
- Pulmonary hypertension persistent 5-15 %
- GERD 50 % (fundoplication 30 %)
- Recurrent hernia 5-15 %
- Neurodevelopmental impairment 15-40 %
- Failure to thrive 30 %
- Skeletal anomalies (chest wall, scoliosis)

## Calculator Bordik

- neo-ino-dose, neo-sildenafil-dose

- AAP COFN, AAP Surgery Section. **Pediatrics 2008** — CDH guidelines
- Tracy ET et al. **Ann Thorac Surg 2010;90:1326** — Patch repair outcomes

articles.summary: TSH screen 24-72 h. Levothyroxine 10-15 мкг/кг/d ASAP при confirmed. Без treatment — irreversible cognitive impairment.
articles.content:
## Эпидемиология

- 1 / 2000-4000 livebirths (range varies — higher в эндемичных йод-deficiency areas)
- 2:1 female:male
- Без лечения: severe cognitive impairment, growth failure (cretinism — historical term)

## Этиология

### Permanent (most common)
- **Thyroid dysgenesis** 75-85 %:
  - Aplasia / agenesis 33 %
  - Ectopic (sublingual) 33 %
  - Hypoplasia 33 %
- **Dyshormonogenesis** 15-25 %:
  - TPO defect (most common)
  - TG defect
  - Pendred syndrome (PDS gene + sensorineural hearing loss)
  - DUOX2 / DUOXA2 defects

### Transient (6-15 % cases)
- Iodine deficiency / excess (maternal)
- Maternal antithyroid drugs (PTU, methimazole)
- Maternal blocking antibodies (TBAb)
- Hereditary TBG abnormalities

### Central (rare, 1-2 %)
- TSH deficiency (pituitary)
- TRH deficiency (hypothalamic)
- Часть panhypopituitarism

## Скрининг

### TSH-based (most common, including РФ + Europe)
- Sample 24-72 ч жизни (sensitive)
- TSH > 20 mU/L: presumptive positive
- Confirm с serum TSH + Free T4
- Treatment ASAP (до day 14)

### T4-based + reflex TSH (US — partly historical)
- T4 < 10th percentile → reflex TSH
- Detects central hypothyroidism

### Cut-offs РФ
- TSH > 9 mU/L на скрининг → recall
- > 18 mU/L → urgent confirmation + treatment start

## Confirmation

- Serum TSH + Free T4 + Total T4
- TSH > 20 mU/L + Free T4 < 12 пмоль/л → CONFIRMED CH
- Borderline cases — repeat at 1-2 нед или treat empirically

### Аdditional workup
- Thyroid УЗИ (presence + size + position)
- Tc-99m / I-123 scan (etiology — if available)
- TBAb если materinal autoimmune disease
- Genetic testing (familial cases, dyshormonogenesis suspected)

## Treatment

### Levothyroxine (T4)
- **Start dose:** 10-15 мкг/кг/d PO once daily
- **Severe (TSH > 50, Free T4 undetectable):** 15 мкг/кг/d
- **Moderate (TSH 20-50):** 12 мкг/кг/d
- **Goal:** **Free T4 в upper-normal range; TSH normalized**
  - Free T4: 17-23 пмоль/л (1.4-2.3 нг/дл)
  - TSH < 5 mU/L

### Administration
- Tablet crushed + small water или breast milk
- Empty stomach (avoid soy, calcium, iron — interfere absorption)
- Same time каждый day

### Monitoring
- TSH + Free T4 в 2 нед after start
- Every 2 нед × 6 нед
- Every 1-2 мес × 6 мес
- Every 3 мес × 1 год
- Every 6 мес × следующие 1-2 года
- Every 12 мес thereafter

## Outcomes

### С early treatment (≤ 14 d жизни)
- IQ normal (compared to siblings)
- Growth normal
- Reduced learning disabilities — но subtle deficits в processing speed, math

### Late treatment (> 4 нед)
- IQ ↓ 5-10 points
- Learning disabilities
- Speech / motor delays

### Без treatment
- Severe cretinism (irreversible cognitive impairment)
- Growth failure
- Goiter (только при dyshormonogenesis)

## Re-evaluation после 3 yr

- Если transient suspected (mild, иод-related, materinal antibodies):
  - Trial of treatment cessation × 4-6 нед
  - Re-test TSH + Free T4
  - If normal — confirm transient

- neo-newborn-screening (timing)

articles.content:
## Definition

PPHN — failure normal pulmonary vascular relaxation после рождения с right-to-left shunting через PDA / PFO.

## Этиология

- **Idiopathic** (essential PPHN — most common)
- **Maladaptation** — sepsis, asphyxia, hypothermia
- **Maldevelopment** — MAS, pneumonia, RDS
- **Pulmonary hypoplasia** — CDH, oligohydramnios

## Targeted therapy hierarchy

### 1. Optimize gas exchange + sedation
- Surfactant если RDS / MAS
- Permissive hypercapnia 45-55 если pH > 7.25
- Sedation + paralysis при labile
- HFOV или HFJV при air leak / persistent hypoxemia

### 2. iNO (Inhaled Nitric Oxide)
- Initial 20 ppm; range 5-20
- Response criteria: PaO₂ ↑ ≥ 20 ИЛИ OI ↓ ≥ 15 % за 30 мин
- Wean 5 ppm q4-12h до 5 ppm; then 1 ppm q1-4h
- Off при FiO₂ < 50 % + stable PaO₂

### 3. Sildenafil (PDE5i)
- IV: 0.4 мг/кг over 3 ч loading, then 1.6 мг/кг/d
- PO: 0.5-2 мг/кг q6h
- Adjunct iNO; rescue в ECMO-bridge

### 4. Milrinone (PDE3i)
- 0.25-0.75 мкг/кг/мин continuous
- Когда LV dysfunction + low CO
- Watch для hypotension — pre-load с volume 10 мл/кг

### 5. Vasopressors maintain SVR > PVR
- Norepinephrine 0.05-1 мкг/кг/мин (preferred)
- Vasopressin 0.0001-0.001 ед/кг/мин (catecholamine-resistant)

### 6. ECMO rescue
- OI > 40 sustained 4 ч
- GA ≥ 34 нед, BW ≥ 2 кг
- Reversible disease
- Без contraindications (severe IVH, lethal anomaly)

articles.summary: Cardiac vs pulmonary vs metabolic. Hyperoxia test (PaO₂ < 100 на FiO₂ 100% → ductal-dependent CHD).
articles.content:
## Patofiziologia

Cyanosis — клиническая desaturation > 5 g/dL deoxygenated Hb. Видна на лице, губах, conjunctiva.

## Главные категории

### 1. Pulmonary
- RDS, TTN, MAS, pneumonia, pneumothorax
- PPHN
- Diaphragmatic hernia

### 2. Cardiac (cyanotic CHD)
- TGA (transposition great arteries)
- TOF (Tetralogy of Fallot)
- TAPVR (total anomalous pulmonary venous return)
- Truncus arteriosus
- HLHS (hypoplastic left heart)
- Tricuspid atresia
- Pulmonary atresia

### 3. Metabolic / hematological
- Methemoglobinemia (congenital или drugs)
- Polycythemia (HCT > 65 %)
- Severe anemia с poor oxygenation

### 4. CNS / sepsis
- Apnea episodes
- Severe sepsis с poor perfusion
- HIE

## Hyperoxia test

- 100 % O₂ × 10 мин via hood / mask
- ABG before + after на right radial artery (preductal)
- **Pulmonary cause:** PaO₂ ≥ 150 мм рт ст (rises significantly)
- **Cardiac cause:** PaO₂ < 100 (no rise — fixed shunting)
- **Equivocal:** PaO₂ 100-150 — repeat or echocardiogram

## Pre/post-ductal SpO₂

- **Pre-ductal** right hand
- **Post-ductal** foot
- **Difference > 5-10 %:** PDA right-to-left shunt → PPHN или ductal-dependent CHD
- **Equal but low:** parallel circulation (TGA, HLHS)
- **Reverse differential** (post > pre):  TGA + critical PDA

## Workup

1. **CCHD pulse oximetry** (24-48 ч)
2. **CXR** — heart size, pulmonary vascularity
3. **ABG** ± lactate
4. **ECG**
5. **Echocardiogram** (gold standard)
6. **Methemoglobin** при подозрении (co-oximetry)
7. **CBC, blood culture**

## Initial management

- Pulse oximetry continuous + ABG
- Bag-mask ventilation если apneic
- O₂ supplementation pending workup
- **PGE1 0.05-0.1 мкг/кг/мин IV** при подозрении ductal-dependent CHD (TGA, HLHS, etc.) — pending echo confirmation
- Empiric antibiotics при sepsis suspected

articles.content:
## Definition

Shock = неадекватное delivery O₂ к тканям → cellular hypoxia + lactic acidosis.

## Категории

### 1. Hypovolemic
- Acute blood loss (placental abruption, ruptured cord, NEC)
- Capillary leak (sepsis early)
- Dehydration (rare у newborn, обычно iatrogenic)

### 2. Cardiogenic
- HIE с myocardial injury
- Asphyxial cardiomyopathy
- Critical CHD (HLHS, severe coarctation)
- Arrhythmias (SVT, AV block)
- Myocarditis

### 3. Distributive (sepsis-related)
- Bacterial sepsis (EOS / LOS)
- Anaphylaxis (rare у newborn)
- Vasoplegia post-cardiac surgery

### 4. Obstructive
- Pneumothorax tension
- Cardiac tamponade
- Massive pulmonary embolism (rare)

## Клиника

- Capillary refill > 3 сек
- Mottled skin
- Cold extremities
- Tachycardia → bradycardia (terminal)
- Hypotension (LATE — after compensation fails)
- Oliguria < 1 мл/кг/ч
- Altered mental status (lethargy)
- Lactate > 2-4 ммоль/л

## Cold vs Warm shock (sepsis-related)

| Параметр | Cold shock | Warm shock |
|---|---|---|
| **Cardiac output** | Low | High |
| **SVR** | High | Low |
| **Mean BP** | Low | Low |
| **Skin** | Cold, mottled, capillary refill > 3 сек | Warm, flushed, bounding pulses |
| **Echo finding** | Poor LV contractility | High CO, normal contractility |
| **First-line vasoactive** | **Adrenaline** 0.05-0.3 мкг/кг/мин | **Noradrenaline** 0.05-1 мкг/кг/мин |

## Surviving Sepsis Campaign Pediatric 2020

### First hour bundle
1. **Fluid resuscitation:** 10-20 мл/кг NS bolus, repeat × 3 prn (max 60 мл/кг first hour) — но cautious в neonate (overload risk)
2. **Empiric ABX** within 1 hour (ампициллин + гентамицин для EOS; vancomycin + cefepime для LOS)
3. **Lactate** + serial monitoring
4. **Vasoactive** if fluid-refractory shock
5. **Hydrocortisone** при absolute adrenal insufficiency

### Vasoactive escalation
1. Cold shock fluid-refractory: **Adrenaline** 0.05-0.3 мкг/кг/мин (start)
2. Warm shock fluid-refractory: **Noradrenaline** 0.05-1 мкг/кг/мин
3. Catecholamine-resistant warm shock: **Vasopressin** 0.0001-0.001 ед/кг/мин
4. LV dysfunction (cardiogenic component): **Dobutamine** или **Milrinone**
5. Refractory: **Hydrocortisone** 1 мг/кг q8-12h IV

### Goals
- MAP > 50 (term), > GA-equivalent (preterm)
- Lactate clearance ≥ 10 % per hour
- Capillary refill < 3 сек
- Urine output > 1 мл/кг/ч
- Mental status improvement

## Adrenal insufficiency

Criteria:
- Persistent hypotension fluid-refractory + escalating vasopressors
- Cortisol < 18 мкг/дл (500 нмоль/л) при stress

**Treatment:** Hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q8-12h IV (stress dose).

## ECMO rescue

VA-ECMO criteria для cardiogenic / refractory septic shock:
- Persistent shock на high-dose vasopressors
- pH < 7.0 + lactate > 5
- Reversible cause

articles.summary: Hypothermia VLBW < 36°C — значимый mortality risk. Golden Hour bundle: pre-warmed room, polyethylene wrap, hat, transport incubator.
articles.content:
## Patofiziologia hypothermii

Newborn — особенно preterm — vulnerable к heat loss из-за:
- High surface area-to-mass ratio
- Thin skin / minimal subcutaneous fat
- ↓ Brown adipose tissue (especially preterm)
- Limited shivering thermogenesis
- Heat loss механизмы: conduction (cold surfaces), convection (air drafts), evaporation (wet skin), radiation (cold surfaces)

## Hypothermia categories (WHO)

| Severity | T core |
|---|---|
| **Cold stress** | 36.0-36.4 °C |
| **Moderate** | 32.0-35.9 °C |
| **Severe** | < 32.0 °C |

**Normothermia target:** 36.5-37.5 °C axillary.

## Outcomes hypothermii

- **VLBW < 36 °C при admission:** ↑ mortality 5x (Laptook 2007 Pediatrics)
- ↑ IVH, NEC, late-onset sepsis
- ↑ Hypoglycemia
- ↑ Pulmonary hemorrhage
- ↑ MV duration

## Golden Hour bundle (first hour after birth)

### Antenatal preparation
- Warm room (≥ 26 °C для VLBW)
- Pre-heated radiant warmer
- Pre-warmed blankets
- Polyethylene wrap / bag (для < 32 нед)
- Transport incubator pre-heated

### Immediate post-delivery
1. **Polyethylene wrap** (без drying) для < 32 нед — covers head + body, leaving face exposed
2. **Hat** (knit или polyethylene)
3. **Skin-to-skin** для term + late preterm — most effective
4. **Pre-warmed bassinet** для transport
5. **Avoid bathing** в первые 6-24 ч (term) или вообще (preterm)

### Resuscitation positioning
- Pre-heated radiant warmer
- Plastic wrap до first stabilization complete
- Heated/humidified gas (если ≥ 6 L/min)
- Continuous T monitoring (skin или axillary probe)

### NICU admission
- Servo-controlled incubator с humidity (60-80 % first 7 d у ELBW)
- Pre-warmed kangaroo mother care когда stable
- T monitoring q1-4h первый day

## Hyperthermia caution

- T > 37.5 °C — sepsis risk + neurological injury
- НЕ рекомендуется prophylactic warming > target
- ⚠️ HIE с inadvertent hyperthermia — worsens outcome

## Therapeutic hypothermia (separate)

See art-cooling — TH 33-34 °C × 72 ч для moderate-severe HIE.

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-thermal-management
- neo-hypothermia-transport

## Источники

- WHO. Thermal Protection of Newborn 1997 + updates
- Laptook AR et al. Pediatrics 2007;119:e643
- McCall EM et al. Cochrane 2018:CD004210 — interventions to prevent hypothermia
- AAP COFN/Educational Programs 2024

articles.title_ru: Glucose monitoring и CGM в NICU
articles.summary: POC glucose капiллярный — стандарт. CGM (Dexcom, Medtronic) появляется в research. Frequency по риску: q30 мин при IDM, q4-6h preterm.
articles.content:
## Modalities

### 1. POC capillary glucose (стандарт)
- Heel stick + glucometer (Accu-Chek, OneTouch, и др.)
- Чувствительность: меньше точности vs venous lab — overestimate низких glucose у hyperHCT
- **При значениях 2.5-3.0 ммоль/л — confirm с lab serum**

### 2. Lab serum glucose (gold standard)
- Slower (15-30 мин)
- Точно: hexokinase method
- 10-15 % lower vs whole blood (plasma higher)

### 3. Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)
- Subcutaneous sensor
- Examples: Dexcom G6/G7, Medtronic Guardian, Abbott Libre 3
- **Research stage у neonates** — accuracy у preterm < 28 нед questionable
- Useful у CHI babies для hourly trends без trauma
- Beardsall study (Lancet 2013) — CGM у VLBW reduced exposure to abnormal levels

## Frequency monitoring (per группы риска)

### High risk — q30 мин first 2 ч, then q1-2h
- IDM (infant of diabetic mother)
- LGA > 90th percentile
- SGA < 10th percentile
- Stress (asphyxia, sepsis, hypothermia)
- Maternal hypoglycemic agents

### Moderate risk — q1-2h первые 12 ч, then q3-4h
- Late preterm 34-36 нед
- Term без feeding established

### Low risk — q4-6h первые 24-48 ч
- Term breast-fed without risk factors

## Action thresholds (PES 2015)

| Час жизни | Threshold treat |
|---|---|
| **0-4 ч** | < 1.7 ммоль/л symptomatic; < 1.4 asymptomatic |
| **4-24 ч** | < 2.2 ммоль/л |
| **> 24 ч** | < 2.5 ммоль/л |
| **> 48 ч persistent** | < 3.3 ммоль/л — workup IEM/CHI |

## Sources hyperglycemia (отдельный issue)

### Causes
- Iatrogenic (high GIR > 12 мг/кг/мин у extreme preterm)
- Stress (sepsis, surgery, asphyxia)
- Drugs (steroids, vasopressors)
- Transient neonatal diabetes (rare — KCNJ11 mutations)
- Permanent neonatal diabetes (PND — neonatal-onset)

### Treatment hyperglycemia
- ↓ GIR if > 12 мг/кг/мин
- Insulin 0.01-0.1 ед/кг/h continuous (с tight monitoring)
- Goal: 4-8 ммоль/л (loose target — avoid hypoglycemia)

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-glucose-bolus-dose
- neo-gir
- neo-insulin-dose

- Thornton PS et al. J Pediatr 2015;167:238 — PES 2015
- Beardsall K et al. Lancet 2013;382:1077 — REACT CGM
- AAP CFN. Pediatrics 2011;127:575
- BAPM Hypoglycemia Framework 2017

articles.title_ru: Электролиты у новорождённых: Na, K, Ca
articles.summary: Hyponatremia preterm — late-onset SIADH-like. Hyperkalemia ELBW first 48 h NOHK. Hypocalcemia early (<72h, IDM, asphyxia) vs late (>72h, vit D / Mg deficiency).
articles.content:
## Sodium (Na)

### Normal range
- Term: 135-145 ммоль/л
- Preterm early (< 7 d): 133-145 (slightly broader)
- Preterm late (> 7 d on TPN): 135-145

### Hyponatremia (Na < 135)

#### Early-onset (< 7 d): обычно dilutional
- Excess fluid administration
- Maternal hyponatremia / IV oxytocin during labor
- SIADH-like (PGE1 use, brain injury)

**Treatment:**
- ↓ Free water intake
- НЕ rapid correction (risk osmotic demyelination)
- Aim: increase Na by ≤ 8-10 ммоль/л per 24 h
- Severe symptomatic (Na < 120, seizures): 3 % NaCl 2-4 мл/кг bolus IV

#### Late-onset (> 7 d): натrium deficit + sodium wasting
- Excessive renal loss (preterm tubular immaturity)
- Diuretic therapy
- BPD with chronic diuretics
- Cerebral salt wasting (rare)

**Treatment:**
- Na supplementation 4-6 ммоль/кг/d (some need 8+)
- ↑ TPN Na content
- НЕ диуретики если возможно

### Hypernatremia (Na > 145)
- Dehydration (transepidermal water loss in ELBW)
- Inadequate free water (concentrated TPN)
- Excessive Na intake (rare)

**Treatment:**
- ↑ Free water (НЕ Hypotonic IVF rapid — gradual correction)
- Fix underlying (humidify incubator, etc.)

## Potassium (K)

### Normal range
- Term: 3.5-5.0 ммоль/л
- Preterm early (< 24 h): up to 6.0
- Preterm > 7 d: 3.5-5.5

### Hyperkalemia

#### Non-oliguric hyperkalemia (NOHK) of ELBW
- Common in ELBW < 1000 g first 48-72 h
- ↑ K despite normal urine output + normal renal function
- Mechanism: K shift из cells (immature Na/K ATPase)
- Treat при K > 6.5 ИЛИ ECG changes

**Treatment по severity:**
- **Mild (K 6-6.5):** ↓ K intake; recheck q4-6h
- **Moderate (K 6.5-7.5):** Insulin + glucose: insulin 0.1 ед/кг IV + dextrose 0.5 г/кг; albuterol nebulizer 0.4 мг/кг q1-2h prn
- **Severe (K > 7.5 или ECG changes):**
  - Calcium gluconate 10 % 1-2 мл/кг IV slow (cardiac stabilization)
  - Insulin + glucose как выше
  - Sodium bicarbonate 1-2 ммоль/кг IV (если acidosis)
  - Furosemide 1 мг/кг IV
  - Kayexalate enema 1 г/кг (rare у preterm)

### Hypokalemia (K < 3.5)
- Diuretic loss (chronic furosemide)
- GI losses (NG suction, NEC, watery stools)
- Alkalosis
- Inadequate K replacement в TPN

**Treatment:**
- ↑ K replacement: 2-4 ммоль/кг/d enteral
- IV correction: 0.5-1 ммоль/кг over 1 h (max 0.5 ммоль/кг/h)
- НЕ rapid IV bolus — risk arrhythmia

## Calcium (Ca)

### Normal range
- **Total:** 2.0-2.5 ммоль/л (8-10 мг/дл)
- **Ionized:** 1.10-1.40 ммоль/л (4.4-5.6 мг/дл)

### Early hypocalcemia (< 72 h)

#### Causes
- Prematurity (parathyroid immaturity)
- IDM (transient hypoparathyroidism)
- Asphyxia (reduced PTH response)
- Maternal hyperparathyroidism

#### Treatment
- Asymptomatic + Ca > 1.75 ммоль/л: oral or supplemented IV TPN
- Symptomatic (jitters, seizures, apnea):
  - **Calcium gluconate 10 % 0.5-1 мл/кг IV slow over 5-10 мин**
  - Continue infusion 50-200 мг/кг/d Ca gluconate в TPN
  - НЕ peripheral IV рекомендуется (extravasation тяжёлая)

### Late hypocalcemia (> 72 h)

#### Causes
- Vitamin D deficiency (maternal или infant)
- Hyperphosphatemia (cow's milk formula — high P)
- Mg deficiency (часто)
- DiGeorge syndrome (22q11 deletion — congenital hypoparathyroidism)
- Renal disease

#### Workup
- Phosphate, Mg, vit D 25-OH
- PTH if hypoparathyroidism suspected
- 22q11 FISH if dysmorphic features

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-cagluconate-dose
- neo-furosemide-dose
- neo-insulin-dose

## Источники

- Vemgal P et al. Cochrane 2012:CD007664 — hyperkalemia preterm
- Kerr SK. Pediatr Endocrinol Rev 2010 — hypocalcemia review
- AAP CFN — Pediatric Nutrition Handbook 2024
- ESPGHAN PN 2018

articles.title_ru: Common NICU procedures — UVC, UAC, intubation
articles.summary: UVC depth (2 × Birth weight) + 0.5 cm. UAC depth — Shukla equation. Intubation depth = 6 + weight. Pre-medication: atropine + fentanyl + paralytic.
articles.content:
## Umbilical Venous Catheter (UVC)

### Indications
- Emergency vascular access (resuscitation)
- Central access первые 7 d жизни
- TPN administration (high osmolarity > 900 мосм/л)
- Exchange transfusion

### Insertion
- **Sterile technique** — gown, gloves, drape
- **Depth formula:** 
  - Term: (2 × birth weight in kg) + 0.5 cm
  - Or: Shukla calculation (3 × BW kg) + 9 / 2 cm
- **Tip position:** above diaphragm at IVC/RA junction (preferred) ИЛИ below liver if non-emergency
- **Confirm position** на CXR — should overlie T9-T10 (above diaphragm)

### Wrong position
- **Too high** (in heart): arrhythmias risk — pull back
- **In liver**: risk hepatic necrosis with hyperosmolar fluids

### Complications
- Portal vein thrombosis
- Hepatic abscess
- Cardiac perforation / tamponade
- Pleural effusion
- Catheter-related bloodstream infection (CRBSI)

### Removal
- ≤ 7-14 d (avoid CRBSI)
- Replace с PICC if longer access needed

## Umbilical Arterial Catheter (UAC)

### Indications
- Continuous BP monitoring
- Frequent blood gas + lab sampling (RDS, MV)
- ABG sampling без peripheral arterial puncture

### Position
- **High position (preferred):** T6-T9 (above diaphragm, between celiac and renal arteries)
- **Low position:** L3-L4 (below renal arteries)
- High position has lower complication rate (Cochrane 2010)

### Depth (Shukla equation)
- High position: (3 × BW kg) + 9 cm
- Low position: BW kg + 7 cm

### Maintenance
- Heparin 0.5-1 ед/мл in line saline
- Or papaverine 60 мг/л NaCl 0.45 % for vasospasm prevention
- Continuous flush 0.5-1 мл/ч

### Complications
- Vasospasm (white toe / leg) — discontinue immediately
- Thrombosis (femoral / aortic)
- NEC association (controversial)
- Bleeding (если accidentally disconnected)

## Endotracheal Intubation

### Pre-medication (NRP recommended unless emergent)
- **Atropine** 20 мкг/кг IV (anti-vagal — prevents bradycardia)
- **Fentanyl** 1-3 мкг/кг IV slow over 5 мин (anti-pain)
- **Paralytic (optional):** rocuronium 1 мг/кг ИЛИ vecuronium 0.1 мг/кг

### ETT size
- < 1000 g: 2.5 mm ID
- 1000-2000 g: 3.0 mm ID
- 2000-3000 g: 3.5 mm ID
- > 3000 g: 3.5-4.0 mm ID

### Depth (oral intubation)
- **Formula:** 6 + weight in kg = depth from upper lip
- E.g., 1.5 kg → 7.5 cm at upper lip

### Confirm position
- Chest rise bilateral
- Breath sounds bilateral + equal
- Mist in tube
- ETCO₂ detector (yellow → confirms tracheal placement)
- HR rise > 100
- CXR within 1 ч (tip at T1-T3 ideal, midway between thoracic inlet and carina)

### Wrong position
- **Right main bronchus** (most common error) — pull back 1-2 cm
- **Esophagus** — clear chest no rise, no ETCO₂ → re-intubate
- **Too high** — extubation risk → push deeper

## PICC line

### Indications
- Long-term TPN (> 7-14 d)
- IV antibiotics > 7 d
- Replacement of UVC after 7-14 d

### Insertion
- 1.9 Fr или 2 Fr catheter
- Insertion site: cubital, basilic, или scalp veins
- Confirm tip position на CXR — superior vena cava (SVC) preferred

## Lumbar Puncture (LP)

### Indications
- Suspected meningitis (sepsis workup)
- HSV ПЦР (CSF)
- Therapeutic — hydrocephalus тaps

### Position
- Sitting infant: knee-to-chest
- Lateral: knee-chest position

### Site
- L3-L4 or L4-L5 interspace
- Mark с line drawn between iliac crests = L4 spinous process

### Stylet + needle
- 22G × 1.5 inch styletted spinal needle preferred
- Avoid bevel-up technique to prevent CSF leak

### Complications
- Traumatic tap (RBC > 1000) — falsely elevate WBC
- Post-LP headache (rare у newborn)
- Spinal hematoma (very rare у newborn)

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-uvc-uac (depth + size + position calc)
- neo-ett (size + depth)
- neo-fentanyl-dose (pre-intubation)
- neo-rocuronium-dose (paralytic)
- neo-atropine-dose (anti-vagal)

articles.summary: LISA через тонкий катетер на CPAP. Poractant alfa 200 mg/kg first dose preferred over beractant. Threshold FiO2 > 0.30 при < 28 нед.
articles.content:
## Что такое сурфактант

Экзогенный surfactant — фосфолипидно-белковый комплекс (SP-A, SP-B, SP-C, SP-D) → reduces alveolar surface tension, prevents atelectasis.

## Препараты

### Poractant alfa (Curosurf — preferred)
- Porcine origin
- 80 мг/мл phospholipid
- **First dose: 200 мг/кг** (2.5 мл/кг)
- Subsequent doses: 100 мг/кг
- Cochrane 2015 — superior к beractant в mortality (11 % vs 16 %)

### Beractant (Survanta)
- Bovine origin
- 25 мг/мл phospholipid
- **First dose: 100 мг/кг** (4 мл/кг)
- Subsequent doses: 100 мг/кг

### Calfactant (Infasurf)
- Bovine origin (whole lung)
- 35 мг/мл phospholipid
- 105 мг/кг (3 мл/кг)

### Synthetic
- Lucinactant (Surfaxin) — discontinued
- CHF5633 — clinical trials (synthetic recombinant)

## Indications

### Prophylactic (НЕ рекомендуется в эру antenatal steroids + CPAP)
- Cochrane 2012 — NO benefit prophylactic vs early rescue
- Reserved для < 26 нед без antenatal steroids

### Early rescue (preferred)
- < 28 нед PMA + FiO₂ > 0.30 на CPAP
- 28-32 нед PMA + FiO₂ > 0.40
- ≥ 32 нед PMA + FiO₂ > 0.50 (RDS confirmed)

### Re-dosing
- Persistent O₂ requirement FiO₂ > 0.30 после 4-6 ч
- ≤ 4 doses total

## Administration techniques

### LISA (Less Invasive Surfactant Administration) — preferred 2024
- Thin catheter (Cathkit / NeoVation) inserted через vocal cords
- Patient remains on CPAP
- Surfactant slow push 30 sec — 1 min
- Catheter removed, CPAP continued
- **Advantages:** ↓ BPD, ↓ MV duration, ↓ pneumothorax (Aldana-Aguirre Cochrane 2021)

### MIST (Minimally Invasive Surfactant Therapy) — same concept as LISA
- Australian terminology
- Same outcome literature

### INSURE (INtubate-SURfactant-Extubate)
- Brief intubation, surfactant via ETT, immediate extubation back to CPAP
- Older standard, now superseded by LISA
- Some RCTs show LISA superior

### Standard (intubate + maintain MV)
- Surfactant via ETT, continue MV
- Reserved для unstable infants requiring prolonged MV

### Aerosolized surfactant (research)
- Nebulized via vibrating mesh
- Less invasive
- AERO-02 trial 2018 negative; ongoing CHF5633 nebulized trials

## Procedure (LISA)

1. **Pre-medication:** atropine 20 мкг/кг IV; sucrose 0.5 мл oral; consider fentanyl 1 мкг/кг (controversial — depresses respiratory drive)
2. **Position:** infant supine, slightly head-down
3. **CPAP** maintained throughout 5-7 cm H₂O
4. **Visualize cords** с laryngoscope (Miller 0 size)
5. **Insert thin catheter** to depth 1-2 cm below cords
6. **Push surfactant** slowly 30-60 sec (NOT bolus)
7. **Remove catheter** — CPAP continues immediately
8. **Monitor SpO₂, HR** — transient desaturation expected

## Complications

- Transient hypoxemia / bradycardia (most common — recovers с CPAP)
- Pulmonary hemorrhage (rare — 1-3 %)
- Coughing / gagging (if high level cord stimulation)
- Backflow (if pushed too fast)

## Outcomes

Meta-analysis (LISA vs INSURE):
- ↓ Need MV first 72 h
- ↓ BPD (NNT ~10)
- ↓ Mortality (modest)
- No increase in IVH

## Calculator Bordik

- neo-rds-class
- neo-resp-indices

## Источники

- Sweet DG et al. Neonatology 2023;120:3 — European Consensus RDS
- Aldana-Aguirre JC et al. Cochrane 2021:CD012878 — LISA vs INSURE
- Bahadue FL, Soll R. Cochrane 2012:CD001456 — Early surfactant
- Pfister RH, Soll RF. Cochrane 2015:CD007836 — Poractant vs beractant

articles.title_en: Inborn Errors of Metabolism (IEM) in Newborns
articles.summary: Острая декомпенсация: IEM-cocktail (биотин/B1/B2/carnitine) + glucose + Ammonul при гипераммонемии. Срочный TMS + plasma AA / urine OA.
articles.content:
## Подозрение на IEM

### Triggers
- Sepsis-like presentation без identifiable infection
- Worsening в первые часы — дни жизни ("honeymoon period" before symptoms)
- Acidosis unexplained (anion gap > 16)
- Hyperammonemia (> 100 µмоль/л у newborn)
- Hypoglycemia persistent (после standard therapy)
- Hepatic dysfunction (jaundice + LFT elevation)
- Failure to thrive с feeds
- Encephalopathy с lethargy / seizures / coma
- Family history previous neonatal death

## Acute presentation patterns

### Encephalopathy + acidosis
- Organic acidemias (propionic, methylmalonic, isovaleric)
- MSUD (Maple Syrup Urine Disease)

### Encephalopathy + hyperammonemia
- Urea cycle disorders (UCD): OTC, CPS1, NAGS deficiency
- Organic acidemias (с secondary hyperammonemia)
- THAN (transient hyperammonemia of newborn)

### Hypoglycemia + hepatomegaly
- Glycogen storage disease type I
- Fatty acid oxidation defects (MCAD, VLCAD, LCHAD)
- Galactosemia

### Liver failure (jaundice + coagulopathy + LFTs)
- Galactosemia
- Tyrosinemia type I
- Mitochondrial disorders

## Initial workup ("IEM panel")

### First-line
- **Glucose** + lactate + ammonia (NH₃)
- **CBC, LFT, coag** (PT, PTT)
- **Electrolytes, anion gap**
- **ABG / VBG** + ketones (urine, blood)
- **TMS (Tandem Mass Spectrometry) — newborn screening result**
- **Plasma amino acids** (PAA)
- **Urine organic acids** (UOA)
- **Plasma acylcarnitine profile**
- **Free + total carnitine**

### Second-line (if specific suspect)
- Pyruvate, succinate (mitochondrial)
- Galactose-1-phosphate (galactosemia)
- Biotinidase activity
- Very long chain fatty acids (VLCFA — peroxisomal)
- CSF lactate, glycine, glucose
- Specific gene panels

## Acute management — "IEM rescue"

### 1. Stop catabolism
- **NPO** — discontinue protein intake immediately
- **D10W IV at GIR 8-10 мг/кг/мин** — provide energy via glucose
- Goal: stop endogenous protein breakdown

### 2. Empiric "IEM cocktail" (while awaiting Dx)
- **Biotin** 10 мг IV/PO daily (multiple carboxylase deficiency)
- **Thiamine (B1)** 100-300 мг IV/PO daily (MSUD thiamine-responsive)
- **Riboflavin (B2)** 100-200 мг daily (MADD/glutaric aciduria)
- **L-Carnitine** 100-300 мг/кг/d IV (organic acidemia secondary deficiency)
- **Hydroxocobalamin (B12)** 1 мг IM daily (methylmalonic aciduria cobalamin-responsive)
- **Folic acid** 5 мг daily
- **Vitamin D** + Ca

### 3. Hyperammonemia management
- **Ammonul (sodium phenylacetate + sodium benzoate):** loading 250 мг/кг IV over 90 мин, then maintenance 250-500 мг/кг/d
- **Arginine HCl** 600 мг/кг loading IV (UCD specific — NOT в OTC if pregnancy)
- **Carglumic acid (Carbaglu)** 100-250 мг/кг/d PO для NAGS deficiency или organic acidemia
- **Hemodialysis (HD) или CRRT** при NH₃ > 500 µмоль/л + encephalopathy — most effective
- **Avoid valproate** (worsens hyperammonemia)

### 4. Acidosis correction (cautious)
- Sodium bicarbonate 1-2 ммоль/кг IV slow if pH < 7.1
- НЕ rapid (alkalemia worsens hypocalcemia)

### 5. Special situations
- **Galactosemia confirmed:** lactose-free formula immediately (Pregestimil или Nutramigen без lactose)
- **MSUD confirmed:** BCAA-restricted formula (special formula)
- **PKU confirmed:** phenylalanine-restricted formula

## Specific disorders — short summary

### Phenylketonuria (PKU)
- Phe accumulation → CNS toxicity
- Treatment: low-Phe diet + sapropterin (BH4) responsive subset
- Lifelong dietary management

### MSUD
- BCKAD deficiency → branched-chain AA accumulation
- "Maple syrup" smell of urine
- Treatment: BCAA-restricted formula; thiamine in responsive subtype

### Methylmalonic / Propionic acidemia
- Defective propionyl-CoA carboxylase или MCM
- Treatment: low-protein diet, B12 (MMA), carnitine, biotin (PA)

### Urea cycle disorders
- Enzyme deficiencies in urea synthesis
- Treatment: ammonia scavengers (Ammonul, sodium phenylbutyrate, carglumic acid), low-protein diet

### Galactosemia
- GALT deficiency
- Treatment: lactose-free diet
- Risk: cataracts, sepsis (E. coli, GBS)

### Glycogen storage disease type I
- G6PC deficiency
- Treatment: continuous overnight feeds + uncooked cornstarch

- neo-carglumic-acid-dose
- neo-glucose-bolus-dose, neo-gir

- Daniotti M et al. Front Pediatr 2020;8:565
- РФ Приказ МЗ 2023 — Расширенный скрининг 36 (включает IEM panel)
- US RUSP HRSA

articles.summary: Симптомный cCMV → ganciclovir 6 мг/кг q12h × 6 нед IV → valganciclovir 16 мг/кг q12h × 6 мес PO. Hearing loss → NDI prevention (CASG 218).
articles.content:
## Эпидемиология

- **Самая частая congenital infection в мире**
- 0.5-2 % всех newborns infected
- 10-15 % из них симптомные при рождении
- 50 % симптомных + 10-15 % asymptomatic — develop hearing loss или NDI

## Передача

- **Transplacental** (primary maternal infection в pregnancy — highest risk)
- Recurrent maternal infection — reduced risk
- Reactivation maternal latent infection — possible
- Перинатально: birth canal exposure (rare cause symptoms)
- Postnatal через milk — common у preterm (asymptomatic у term)

## Симптомы при рождении

### Severe cCMV (CNS-involving — 10-15 %)
- IUGR / SGA
- Microcephaly
- Periventricular calcifications (CT/MRI)
- Chorioretinitis
- Sensorineural hearing loss (SNHL) — 30-50 % симптомных
- Hepatosplenomegaly
- Petechial rash ("blueberry muffin")
- Thrombocytopenia
- Direct hyperbilirubinemia
- Neonatal seizures

### Mild cCMV
- Mild thrombocytopenia
- Mild jaundice
- Petechiae

### Asymptomatic (90 % cCMV)
- No clinical findings at birth
- 10-15 % develop later SNHL

## Диагностика

### При рождении (в первые 21 день — gold standard)
- **CMV ПЦР урины** (most sensitive)
- **CMV ПЦР слюны** (saliva swab) — convenient screening
- **CMV ПЦР крови** (less sensitive в asymptomatic)
- IgM не reliable у newborn
- **DBS (dried blood spot)** ПЦР — retrospective Dx (RUSP в развитии в US)

### NB!
- Sample > 21 d жизни — нельзя differentiate cCMV vs perinatal/postnatal
- Newborn screening для cCMV — расширяется (Minnesota 2023, Europe pilots)

### При confirmed cCMV — workup
- **Cranial ultrasound** + MRI brain (calcifications, ventriculomegaly, white matter)
- **Ophthalmology** — chorioretinitis
- **Audiology screen** AABR + diagnostic
- **CBC, LFT, bilirubin**
- **CMV ПЦР CSF** если CNS involvement
- **Coag, retics** при thrombocytopenia

## Лечение

### Symptomatic cCMV (CASG 218 protocol — Kimberlin NEJM 2015)
- **Ganciclovir 6 мг/кг IV q12h × 2-6 weeks** (often 2 weeks if no IV access issues, then transition)
- **Switch к Valganciclovir PO 16 мг/кг q12h × 6 months total**
- **Or all-PO 6 months valganciclovir** if mild-moderate disease and PO tolerated

### Outcomes treated vs untreated
- 6-month therapy improves hearing outcomes (CASG 218)
- Improves neurodevelopmental outcomes long-term
- Reduces hearing deterioration

### Side effects monitoring
- **Neutropenia** (40 % — dose-limiting) — discontinue if ANC < 500
- **Thrombocytopenia, anemia**
- **Hepatotoxicity** — LFT weekly
- **Renal dysfunction** — creatinine
- **CBC weekly** first 6 weeks, then q2-4 нед × 6 months

### Asymptomatic + isolated SNHL
- Treatment controversial — ongoing trials (CONCERT)
- Some centers treat all symptomatic + isolated SNHL
- Decision shared с family + ID

### Asymptomatic + normal hearing
- НЕ treatment (current)
- Audiology surveillance до 6 yr (delayed-onset SNHL до 30 % cases)

## Профилактика

### Maternal
- Hand hygiene (особенно при contact с детскими saliva/urine)
- Avoid sharing food / utensils с toddlers
- Avoid kissing on lips

### Postnatal CMV у preterm (через breast milk)
- ELBW < 1500 g — risk symptomatic infection (cCMV-like syndrome)
- Preventive: freeze-thaw (-20 °C × 24 h) breast milk "reduces" but not eliminates
- Holder pasteurization (62.5 °C × 30 мин) — eliminates
- Donor milk pasteurized — safe
- Maternal milk for ELBW — controversial; some centers treat or pasteurize for selected very high-risk

- neo-perinatal-infections-class

- AAP Red Book 2024-2027 (CMV)
- Italian Consensus on cCMV 2024
- Lanzieri TM et al. Pediatrics 2017;139:e20162610

articles.summary: 3 формы: SEM, CNS, disseminated. Acyclovir 60 мг/кг/d × 14 d (SEM) или 21 d (CNS/disseminated). Mortality disseminated 30 %.
articles.content:
## Эпидемиология

- Incidence: 1 / 3000-20,000 livebirths
- Mortality untreated: 30-50 % disseminated; 4-15 % CNS
- Even с treatment: 20-30 % long-term sequelae

## Передача

- **Intrapartum (85 %)** — passage через infected birth canal
- **In utero (5 %)** — transplacental (rare, severe)
- **Postnatal (10 %)** — contact с oral/skin lesions caregivers

### Risk factors
- **Primary maternal infection** в third trimester — highest risk transmission (30-50 %)
- Recurrent maternal infection — much lower (1-3 %)
- Active genital lesions при labor — C-section indication

## Клинические формы

### 1. SEM disease (Skin-Eye-Mouth) — 45 %
- Vesicular skin lesions (clusters, often scalp/eyelids/oral)
- Conjunctivitis / keratitis
- Vesicles на oral mucosa
- **Без CNS / disseminated involvement**
- Mortality < 1 %
- Long-term: skin recurrences, eye damage

### 2. CNS disease — 30 %
- Lethargy, irritability, poor feeding
- Seizures (often focal)
- Bulging fontanelle
- Apnea
- Скin lesions only 60 % cases (40 % NO skin lesions)
- Onset 10-21 d (later than SEM)
- Mortality 4-15 %; long-term NDI 70 %

### 3. Disseminated disease — 25 %
- Sepsis-like syndrome
- Multi-organ involvement (liver, lungs, adrenals, CNS)
- DIC, shock
- Hepatitis (LFT > 1000)
- Pneumonitis
- Skin lesions only 70 %
- Onset 5-14 d
- Mortality 30 %; survivors 17 % NDI

## Диагностика

### High suspicion
- Vesicular rash
- Sepsis-like illness без bacterial source
- Hepatitis + thrombocytopenia
- Seizures + CSF pleocytosis
- Maternal HSV history (especially primary)

### Workup
- **HSV ПЦР CSF** — gold standard CNS
- **HSV ПЦР blood** (often positive disseminated)
- **HSV ПЦР surface swabs** (mouth, nasopharynx, eyes, anal/rectal) — 100 %+ sensitivity
- **HSV culture skin lesion** swab
- **CSF cell count + protein + glucose**
- **CBC, LFT, coag**
- **CXR** (pneumonitis)
- **EEG** (CNS — temporal slowing)
- **MRI brain** (T2 hyperintensities в temporal lobes — typical)

## Лечение

### Empirical при suspect (PRIOR to confirmation)
- **Acyclovir 60 мг/кг/d IV** divided q8h
- При severe / unstable: continue empiric × 14-21 d while testing

### Confirmed
- **SEM disease:** 14 days IV
- **CNS or disseminated:** **21 days IV**
- Repeat CSF ПЦР at end of treatment
- **If CSF ПЦР still positive:** continue treatment additional 7 d, recheck

### Suppressive therapy after acute
- **Oral acyclovir 300 мг/м² q8h × 6 months** PO
- ↓ Cutaneous recurrences
- ↓ Neurodevelopmental abnormalities (Kimberlin 2011 NEJM)
- Monitor neutrophils q2 нед

### Side effects acyclovir
- Renal dysfunction (crystallization) — adequate hydration critical
- Neutropenia (rare)
- Phlebitis IV site

## Profилактика

### Maternal
- C-section if active genital lesions при labor
- Suppressive therapy (acyclovir/valacyclovir) от 36 нед if recurrent genital herpes — ↓ recurrence at delivery

### NICU
- Healthcare workers с oral lesions — mask, restrict from neonate care
- Family education

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-acyclovir-dose, neo-foscarnet-dose
- neo-perinatal-infections-class

## Источники

- Kimberlin DW et al. NEJM 2011;365:1284 — Suppressive therapy
- ACOG Practice Bulletin 220 (2020) — Maternal HSV
- AAP Red Book 2024-2027
- Workowski KA et al. STD Treatment Guidelines 2021 (CDC)

articles.summary: ICROP3 staging. Screen GA ≤ 32 нед или BW ≤ 1500 g от 31 нед PMA. Treatment Type 1 ROP — anti-VEGF (Lucentis) или laser. RAINBOW 2019.
articles.content:
## ICROP3 (International Classification of ROP — 3rd ed., 2021)

### Зоны
- **Zone I:** круг радиусом 30° (2 × disc-fovea distance) центрированный на disc — most posterior, severe
- **Zone II:** от Zone I до nasal ora serrata
- **Zone III:** остальная temporal retina (least severe)

### Stages
- **Stage 1:** demarcation line
- **Stage 2:** ridge ("valley")
- **Stage 3:** ridge + extra-retinal vascular proliferation (NV)
- **Stage 4:** partial retinal detachment
  - 4A: extra-foveal
  - 4B: foveal involvement
- **Stage 5:** total retinal detachment ("funnel")

### Plus disease ("+")
- Engorgement + tortuosity central retinal vessels
- Critical sign активной болезни

### Pre-plus
- Mild dilation/tortuosity между normal и plus

### A-ROP (Aggressive ROP — replaces AP-ROP в ICROP3)
- Severe, rapidly progressive
- Часто Zone I posterior
- Aggressive treatment indicated

## Type 1 vs Type 2 (ETROP 2003)

**Type 1 (treatment indicated):**
- Zone I, любая stage с plus
- Zone I, stage 3 без plus
- Zone II, stage 2 или 3 с plus

**Type 2 (close observation):**
- Zone I, stage 1 или 2 без plus
- Zone II, stage 3 без plus

## Скрининг

### Кого
- GA ≤ 32 нед (OR BW ≤ 1500 g)
- GA 32-36 нед с unstable course (clinical judgment)

### Когда (first exam)

| GA при рождении | Первый exam |
|---|---|
| 22-26 нед | 31 нед PMA |
| 27-30 нед | 4 нед PNA или 31 нед PMA — позднее |
| 31-32 нед | 4 нед PNA |

См. neo-rop-screen-timing для interactive.

### Frequency
- Normal exam: q2 нед
- Stage 1-2 в Zone II или any в Zone I: q1 нед
- Type 1 ROP detected: treatment within 48-72 ч

### Discontinuation
- **Mature retina** (full vascularization до ora serrata)
- **Type 1 reaches treatment** + post-treatment regression
- **Stage 5 with stable funnel** (no further intervention)

### Метод exam
- Indirect ophthalmoscopy с 28D или 30D lens
- Дилатация: cyclopentolate 0.5 % + phenylephrine 2.5 % (1 drop каждый × 2 за 30 мин)
- Lid speculum + scleral depression
- RetCam imaging (digital documentation, telemedicine)

## Treatment options (Type 1 ROP)

### 1. Anti-VEGF — preferred 2024 (especially Zone I)

#### Bevacizumab (Avastin — off-label)
- 0.625 мг (0.025 мл of 25 мг/мл) intravitreal injection
- BEAT-ROP NEJM 2011 (Mintz-Hittner) — superior к laser в Zone I posterior
- НО: systemic absorption confirmed; long-term cognitive concerns
- Single injection обычно sufficient

#### Ranibizumab (Lucentis — FDA approved 2022)
- 0.2 мг intravitreal
- RAINBOW Lancet 2019 (Stahl) — equivalent bevacizumab efficacy
- Less systemic absorption (preferred profile)
- Now "first-choice" anti-VEGF в US

#### Aflibercept (Eylea — FDA approved 2023)
- Newer option — FIREFLEYE trial
- 0.4 мг intravitreal

### 2. Laser photocoagulation
- Treats avascular peripheral retina
- Indirect laser delivery (28D lens)
- Near-confluent burns
- Older standard, still useful Zone II posterior
- Permanent destruction peripheral retina (visual field loss)

### 3. Vitrectomy (Stage 4-5)
- Pediatric vitreoretinal specialist
- Stage 4B / 5 — limited visual prognosis
- Improves anatomic outcome but visual gain modest

## Profilaktika

### Permissive oxygen
- SpO₂ target 90-95 % (NeOProM meta-analysis 2018)
- НЕ < 85 % (mortality ↑)
- НЕ > 95 % (ROP ↑)

### Antenatal corticosteroids
- ↓ ROP severity (mature retina быстрее)

### Vitamin A supplementation
- Cochrane 2022 — uncertain benefit

### Caffeine
- CAP trial — ↓ ROP requiring treatment

### IGF-1 normalization (research)
- rhIGF-1 trials slowing phase 1

### DHA / omega-3 supplementation
- ROP/IUFD trial (Smith 2020) — protective

## Outcomes

### Treatment efficacy
- ICROP3 Type 1 ROP с anti-VEGF or laser: ~90 % anatomic recovery
- Long-term visual: 80-90 % normal или near-normal vision

### Morbidity
- **Refractive errors:** myopia (50 %), astigmatism, anisometropia
- **Strabismus** 15-20 %
- **Late retinal detachment** (years post-treatment)
- **Glaucoma** (rare)

## Follow-up after discharge

- Every 1-2 нед while still developing
- After mature retina: 6 мес, 1 год, then annually for refraction
- Glasses prescription often начинается early

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-icrop3 (staging interactive)
- neo-rop-screen-timing (when to start screening)
- neo-prematurity-class

## Источники

- Chiang MF et al. Ophthalmology 2021;128:e51 — ICROP3
- Mintz-Hittner HA et al. NEJM 2011;364:603 — BEAT-ROP
- Stahl A et al. Lancet 2019;394:1551 — RAINBOW
- ETROP Cooperative Group. Arch Ophthalmol 2003;121:1684
- AAP/AAO/AAPOS. Pediatrics 2018;142:e20183061

articles.summary: TTTS, sIUGR, TAPS — мониторинг. Cocoon care preferred. Discordant growth — отдельный подход к выписке.
articles.content:
## Twin pregnancies — типы

### Chorionic + amniotic
| Тип | Frequency | Risk |
|---|---|---|
| **Dichorionic-diamniotic (DCDA)** | 70 % twins | Lowest risk; baseline |
| **Monochorionic-diamniotic (MCDA)** | 25-30 % | TTTS, sIUGR, TAPS, fetal demise |
| **Monochorionic-monoamniotic (MCMA)** | 1-2 % | Cord entanglement (high mortality) |

### Zygosity vs chorionicity
- Dizygotic: always DCDA
- Monozygotic: variable depending on time of split
  - 0-3 d: DCDA (30 % monozygotic)
  - 4-8 d: MCDA (most common monozygotic)
  - 9-12 d: MCMA
  - > 13 d: conjoined twins

## MCDA-specific complications

### TTTS (Twin-to-Twin Transfusion Syndrome)
- 10-15 % MC twins
- Net unbalanced transfusion through placental anastomoses
- **Donor:** anemia, oligohydramnios, IUGR
- **Recipient:** polycythemia, polyhydramnios, hydrops, cardiomyopathy

#### Quintero staging
| Stage | Critria |
|---|---|
| **I** | Discordant amniotic fluid (oligo donor + poly recipient); donor bladder visible |
| **II** | Donor bladder NOT visible |
| **III** | Abnormal Doppler (UA, ductus venosus, MCA-PSV) |
| **IV** | Hydrops в одном или обоих |
| **V** | Demise одного или обоих |

#### Treatment TTTS
- **Fetoscopic laser ablation** (Solomon technique — preferred ≥ 26 нед)
- Amnioreduction (palliative)
- Selective cord coagulation (severe single-twin compromise)
- Expectant management для Stage I — некоторые resolve spontaneously

### sIUGR (selective IUGR)
- 10-15 % MCDA
- 1 twin SGA (< 10th percentile) + EFW discordance > 25 %
- 3 types по UA Doppler
- Treatment: serial Doppler monitoring; fetoscopic laser if Stage III с sFGR

### TAPS (Twin Anemia Polycythemia Sequence)
- 2-5 % MCDA, до 13 % после TTTS laser
- Chronic small-volume transfusion → anemia donor + polycythemia recipient
- Diagnostic: MCA-PSV doppler discordance > 0.5 MoM
- Treatment: in utero transfusion donor + partial exchange recipient

### MCMA cord entanglement
- Continuous cord entanglement near-universal
- Mortality 5-10 % despite monitoring
- Delivery: planned C-section при 32-34 нед (after antenatal steroids)

## Postnatal management

### Common to all twins
- Co-bedding: kangaroo с матерью whenever stable
- Synchronous feeding schedule
- Differentiation by markers (color-coded ID, baby A vs B)
- Avoid mistakes — separate medical record для каждого

### Discordant growth twins
- Separate feeding goals
- IUGR twin может потребовать TPN longer
- Earlier discharge для larger twin (separate decisions)

### TTTS survivors
#### Donor
- Anemia at birth (Hb < 130 g/l)
- Hypoglycemia
- Postnatal renal dysfunction (oligohydramnios prenatal)
- Long-term: ↑ NDI risk

#### Recipient
- Polycythemia (HCT > 65 %) — partial exchange transfusion (см. neo-partial-exchange)
- Cardiomyopathy (echocardiogram)
- Pulmonary stenosis (right-sided cardiac changes)
- Long-term: ↑ NDI risk

### Co-twin demise
- 25 % risk neurological injury (porencephalic cyst, ischemic stroke)
- MRI brain в 2-4 нед
- Audiology + ophthalmology screening
- Early intervention referral

## Discharge

### Together vs separately
- Most centers — separately when each meets criteria (avoid one twin holding back other's discharge)
- Some centers — together regardless для родительской поддержки
- Decision shared с family

### Family preparation
- Twin feeding техника (tandem nursing, bottles)
- Sleep coordination (synchronized или separate?)
- Distinguishing twins (markers, colors)
- Multi-baby developmental milestones — NDI rates ↑ in MCMA, MCDA с TTTS history

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-partial-exchange (polycythemia)
- neo-prematurity-class

## Источники

- ISUOG Guidelines 2016 — Twin pregnancy ultrasound
- ACOG Practice Bulletin 169 (2016) — Multifetal Gestations
- Society for Maternal-Fetal Medicine 2019 — TTTS management
- Khalil A et al. Ultrasound Obstet Gynecol 2018;52:147 — sIUGR
- Slaghekke F et al. Lancet 2014;383:2144 — Solomon technique

articles.summary: Massive hemorrhage в первые 1-3 дня жизни. Mortality 50-80 %. Treatment: HFOV + high PEEP + correct coag + replace surfactant.
articles.content:
## Definition

Pulmonary hemorrhage — massive frank blood from ETT или upper airway, sustained, accompanied by respiratory deterioration.

**НЕ путать с:**
- Light pink-tinged secretions (often trauma from suction)
- Trace blood streak

## Эпидемиология

- Incidence: 1-5 % VLBW; up to 12 % ELBW
- **Mortality: 50-80 %** (one of the highest causes of neonatal death)
- Long-term morbidity: BPD, neurodev impairment в выживших

## Patofiziologia

Патофизиология не fully understood, но involves:
1. **Acute LV failure** — left-to-right shunt через PDA → ↑ pulmonary blood flow → capillary stress failure
2. **Capillary endothelial damage** — sepsis, hypoxia, surfactant therapy
3. **Coagulopathy** — DIC, vit K deficiency, thrombocytopenia
4. **Hemodynamic shifts** — surfactant administration → rapid ↓ PVR → ↑ pulmonary blood flow

## Risk факторы

- **Prematurity** — особенно ELBW < 1000 g
- **PDA** — большой left-to-right shunt
- **Surfactant administration** — paradoxical risk first 24 ч (pulmonary vascular bed reopens)
- **Severe RDS**
- **HIE / asphyxia**
- **Sepsis** (especially Gram-negative)
- **DIC, coagulopathy**
- **Maternal cocaine use** (vasoconstriction → ischemic damage)
- **Twin-twin transfusion** (recipient)

## Клиника

### Sudden onset (most common первые 1-3 d)
- Bright red blood from ETT or upper airway
- Acute respiratory deterioration
- Hypoxemia despite increased FiO₂
- Bradycardia
- Hypotension
- Pale, dusky color

### Imaging
- **CXR:** "white-out" both lungs ("snowstorm")
- Bilateral diffuse opacification
- Cardiomegaly возможна (PDA)

### Lab
- ↓ HCT (acute blood loss)
- DIC (↑ PT, PTT; ↓ platelets; ↓ fibrinogen; ↑ D-dimer)
- Acidosis

## Treatment — emergency

### 1. Airway / ventilation
- **DO NOT extubate**
- **DO NOT lavage** (washes surfactant)
- **Suction blood** только if obstructing — gentle, brief
- **Increase MAP** (mean airway pressure):
  - PIP до 25-30 см H₂O
  - PEEP до 8-10 см H₂O (high — "tamponade" effect on capillaries)
  - I:E 1:1 if needed
- **HFOV** preferred — high MAP с less barotrauma
- **FiO₂ 100 %** during acute event, wean as O₂ allows

### 2. Hemodynamic
- **PRBC transfusion** 10-15 мл/кг для acute blood loss
- **Inotropes** prn (dopamine, epinephrine) для hypotension
- **PDA closure** if HSPDA — ibuprofen contraindicated в acute setting; consider после stabilization
- **Volume cautious** — overload worsens edema

### 3. Correct coagulopathy
- **FFP** 10-15 мл/кг для PT/PTT prolongation
- **Cryoprecipitate** или **fibrinogen concentrate** for fibrinogen < 1.0 г/л
- **Platelets** transfusion for < 50,000
- **Vit K** 1 мг IV если not given previously
- **Recombinant Factor VIIa** — last-resort (off-label, очень severe cases)

### 4. Replace surfactant
- **Beractant or poractant** 100-200 мг/кг intratracheal
- Replaces washed-out surfactant
- Often improves oxygenation

### 5. Identify trigger
- **Septic workup** + empiric ABX
- **PDA echo** — assess significance
- **Coag panel + DIC labs**
- **Glucose, electrolytes** (correct any abnormalities)

## Outcomes

### Acute mortality
- Massive PH first 1-3 d: 50-80 %
- Surviving 24 ч: better prognosis but BPD risk high

### Long-term morbidity (survivors)
- BPD severe — chronic O₂ dependence
- Neurodev impairment ↑
- Pulmonary HTN

## Profilaktika

- Antenatal corticosteroids — ↓ severe RDS, ↓ pulmonary hemorrhage
- Avoid prophylactic surfactant у > 26 нед — early rescue preferred
- **Indomethacin or ibuprofen prophylaxis** (controversial — may ↓ severe IVH and pulmonary hemorrhage у extreme preterm; see PIVH trial)
- Tight glucose control
- Sepsis prevention bundles (catheter care, hand hygiene)

- neo-papile (IVH risk co-occurs)

articles.summary: Pneumothorax — needle decompression если tension. PIE — gentle ventilation, lateral positioning. HFOV preferred при air leak.
articles.content:
## Categorii

### 1. Pneumothorax (most common air leak)
- Air в pleural space
- ~1 % normal newborns (asymptomatic), 5-10 % VLBW on MV

### 2. Pneumomediastinum
- Air в mediastinum
- Often asymptomatic, self-resolves
- May progress к pneumothorax / pneumopericardium

### 3. PIE (Pulmonary Interstitial Emphysema)
- Air dissecting in interstitium
- Honeycombing на CXR
- Severe → tension PIE → cardiovascular compromise

### 4. Pneumopericardium
- Air в pericardial sac
- Rare but life-threatening (cardiac tamponade)

### 5. Pneumoperitoneum
- Air в peritoneal cavity (often via diaphragmatic dissection)
- НЕ confuse с GI perforation (NEC)

### 6. Pneumoretroperitoneum (rare)

## Risk факторы

- **Mechanical ventilation** (high PIP, PEEP, tidal volume)
- **RDS** (heterogeneous lung compliance)
- **MAS** (ball-valve effect — meconium plugs)
- **Surfactant** administration (uneven distribution)
- **Resuscitation** trauma (excessive PPV)
- **Term infants:** spontaneous pneumothorax (~1 %), often associated с congenital lung anomalies или transient tachypnea

## Pneumothorax

### Клиника
- Sudden respiratory deterioration на MV
- Asymmetric chest expansion (decreased on affected side)
- Decreased breath sounds на affected side
- Hyperresonance к percussion
- Mediastinal shift (heart sounds shifted)
- Hypotension, bradycardia (tension)

### Диагностика
- **Transillumination** (cool light fiber-optic source) — bedside, immediate
  - Affected side glows brighter (positive)
  - Bilateral pneumothorax — both sides glow
- **CXR** confirmation
  - Lung edge visible
  - Loss of vascular markings peripherally
- **POCUS** ultrasound (modern alternative — bedside, no radiation)
  - Absent lung sliding
  - Lung point sign

### Treatment

#### Asymptomatic pneumothorax (small)
- 100 % O₂ × 2-4 ч ("nitrogen washout") — speeds resorption
- Serial CXR
- Спонтанное resolution в 1-2 d

#### Symptomatic pneumothorax
- **Needle decompression** (emergency — tension):
  - 20G IV catheter
  - 2nd intercostal space, midclavicular line
  - Connect к 3-way stopcock + 60 мл syringe
  - Aspirate air
- **Chest tube** (definitive):
  - 8-12 Fr (preterm), 12-14 Fr (term)
  - 4th-5th intercostal space, anterior axillary line
  - Connect к underwater seal или Heimlich valve
  - Suction -10 до -15 см H₂O
  - Remove когда no air leak × 24 ч + lung re-expanded

## PIE (Pulmonary Interstitial Emphysema)

### Клиника
- Worsening respiratory status
- Increasing FiO₂ requirement
- Rising PaCO₂
- CXR: cystic / honeycombing pattern

### Treatment
- **Lateral positioning** affected side down (decreases ventilation, allows healing)
- **HFOV** strongly preferred (allows lower MAP, better ventilation без barotrauma)
- **Permissive hypercapnia** (avoid high tidal volumes)
- **Decompression** (rare — only severe local PIE):
  - Selective bronchial intubation contralateral
  - Surgery (pulmonary resection — last-resort)
- **Steroid trial** — controversial (Cochrane 2010 — uncertain benefit)

## Pneumopericardium

### Emergency tap
- Subxiphoid needle approach
- 22G angiocath connected к syringe
- Aspirate air
- Indication: cardiovascular compromise (hypotension + bradycardia + muffled heart sounds)

## Profilaktika

### Ventilation strategies
- **Volume-targeted ventilation** (VTV) — preferred
- Tidal volume 4-6 мл/кг
- **Permissive hypercapnia** (PaCO₂ 50-60 if pH > 7.25)
- **Permissive hypoxemia** (SpO₂ 90-95 %)
- Avoid high PIP (> 30 см H₂O)
- **HFOV for severe RDS / MAS**

### Resuscitation
- Avoid bag-mask hyperventilation
- Use T-piece resuscitator with manometer
- PIP 20-25 (term) или 20-25 (preterm) initial

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-resp-indices
- neo-ett (size + depth)

## Источники

- Litmanovitz I, Carlo WA. Pediatr Pulmonol 2008;43:339
- Bhatia JM. Clin Perinatol 2008;35:153 — Air leak management
- Soll RF, Pfister RH. NeoReviews 2014;15:e388 — Pneumothorax
- AAP COFN 2024 — Respiratory care
references: Litmanovitz I, Carlo WA. Pediatr Pulmonol 2008;43:339

articles.summary: Vit K profilaktika 1 мг IM ВСЕМ при рождении. VKDB classical (2-7 d), late (2-12 нед) — ICH risk. DIC vs sepsis-driven coag.
articles.content:
## Развитие гemostatic system

- Coagulation factors (vit K-dependent: II, VII, IX, X) — низкие у newborn (40-70 % adult level)
- Anticoagulant proteins (Protein C, S, AT) — also low
- Net result: relatively balanced hemostasis, vulnerable к decompensation
- Term достигает adult coag values к 6 мес
- Preterm — даже ниже + slower maturation

## VKDB (Vitamin K Deficiency Bleeding)

### Категории

| Тип | Onset | Risk без profilaktiki | Profilaktika prevented |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Early** | 0-24 ч | Maternal anti-coags / anti-epileptic drugs | NO (need maternal Vit K) |
| **Classical** | 2-7 d | 0.25-1.7 / 1000 livebirths | YES (1 мг IM dose) |
| **Late** | 2 нед — 6 мес | 5-7 / 100,000 (peak ~4-6 нед) | YES (IM > PO) |

### Late VKDB особенности
- ICH (intracranial hemorrhage) в 50 %
- Mortality 20 %; survivors с long-term NDI
- Risk факторы:
  - Exclusive breastfeeding (low vit K в milk)
  - Cholestasis (malabsorption)
  - Cystic fibrosis
  - Antibiotics (gut flora disruption)
  - Maternal anti-epileptic drugs

### Profilaktika (AAP / WHO recommendation)
- **Все newborns:** Vit K 1 мг IM в первые 6 ч (или до выписки)
- **Preterm < 1500 г:** 0.5 мг IM

### PO alternative (если IM refused)
- 2 мг PO at birth + 2 мг при 1 нед + 2 мг при 4 нед
- НЕ как effective как IM (особенно для late VKDB)
- AAP COFN 2022 — IM preferred

### Acute VKDB treatment
- **Vit K 1-2 мг IV slow** (NOT IM in active bleeding — hematoma)
- **FFP 10-15 мл/кг** для immediate factor replacement
- **Prothrombin Complex Concentrate (PCC) 25-50 ед/кг** при life-threatening bleeding (off-label)
- **Recombinant Factor VIIa** (last-resort)

## DIC (Disseminated Intravascular Coagulation)

### Triggers у newborn
- Sepsis (especially Gram-negative)
- HIE / asphyxia
- Severe RDS
- NEC / GI infection
- Maternal HELLP / abruption
- Massive blood loss / shock

### Лабораторные maркеры
- ↑ PT, PTT (consumption)
- ↓ Fibrinogen (< 1.5 g/l severe)
- ↑ D-dimer / FDP
- ↓ Platelets (often < 100)
- Schistocytes (microangiopathy)
- ↑ Lactate (tissue hypoperfusion)

### Treatment
- **Address underlying cause** (sepsis, asphyxia, etc.)
- **FFP** 10-15 мл/кг для PT/PTT > 1.5x
- **Cryoprecipitate** 5-10 мл/кг для fibrinogen < 1.0 г/л
- **Platelets** transfusion для < 50,000 (or < 20,000 если non-bleeding)
- **PRBC** для acute blood loss / Hb < 80
- **Heparin** — NOT routinely (controversial у newborn — risk increases bleeding)
- **Recombinant Factor VIIa** — refractory bleeding (off-label)
- Avoid antifibrinolytics (tranexamic acid) у newborn — limited data

## Hemophilia in newborn

### Presentation
- Family history (X-linked recessive — Factor VIII or IX deficiency)
- ICH (10 % present с ICH within first month)
- Cephalohematoma extensive
- Bleeding after circumcision / heel stick
- Joint bleeding не typical у newborn

### Workup
- aPTT prolonged (PT, fibrinogen normal)
- Factor VIII (hemophilia A) или Factor IX (hemophilia B) levels
- Vit K-dependent factors normal
- Genetic testing

### Treatment
- **Hemophilia A:** Recombinant Factor VIII 25-50 ед/кг
- **Hemophilia B:** Recombinant Factor IX 50-100 ед/кг
- **DDAVP** (mild Factor VIII deficiency — releases stored)

## Thrombocytopenia neonatal

### Категории

| Тип | Onset | Cause |
|---|---|---|
| **Early (< 72 h)** | First 3 d | Maternal (NAIT — neonatal alloimmune); placental insufficiency; sepsis |
| **Late (> 72 h)** | After 3 d | Sepsis / NEC; CMV / TORCH; drugs; bone marrow failure |

### NAIT (Neonatal Alloimmune Thrombocytopenia)
- Maternal antibodies (anti-HPA-1a most common) против fetal platelets
- Severe thrombocytopenia (< 30,000 frequently)
- ICH risk до 20 % untreated
- Treatment:
  - Maternal или HPA-matched platelets (ideal)
  - IVIG 1 г/кг daily × 2-5 d
  - Prednisone
- Future pregnancies: maternal IVIG + steroids в pregnancy

### Treatment thresholds platelet transfusion (PlaNeT-2 RCT 2019)
- **Symptomatic bleeding:** transfuse при any platelet count
- **Asymptomatic stable:** transfuse при < 25,000 (more restrictive than older 50,000 threshold)
- **Asymptomatic + risk факторы:** transfuse при < 50,000

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-vitk-dose
- neo-recombinant-factor-vii
- neo-heparin-dose (с осторожностью)

## Источники

- AAP COFN. Pediatrics 2022 — Vit K Position Statement (IM preferred)
- WHO. Newborn Care Guidelines 2017
- Curley A et al. NEJM 2019;380:242 — PlaNeT-2 platelet thresholds
- Sola-Visner M. Hematology Am Soc Hematol Educ Program 2012
- Roberts I. Br J Haematol 2008;141:312 — DIC management
references: Curley A et al. NEJM 2019;380:242 — PlaNeT-2

articles.summary: Ductal-dependent CHD — PGE1 0.05-0.1 мкг/кг/мин. Norwood, Glenn, Fontan stages для HLHS. Post-op: low CO syndrome, milrinone, NIRS.
articles.content:
## Ductal-dependent CHD — PGE1

### Который шунт-зависим
- **Pulmonary blood flow-dependent:** Pulmonary atresia, severe ToF, tricuspid atresia
- **Systemic blood flow-dependent:** HLHS, severe coarctation, interrupted aortic arch, critical aortic stenosis
- **Mixing-dependent:** TGA с restrictive PFO + closing PDA

### PGE1 (Alprostadil) administration
- **Initial:** 0.05 мкг/кг/мин IV continuous (sometimes 0.1)
- **Maintenance:** 0.01-0.05 мкг/кг/мин (titrate to maintain ductal patency)
- **Duration:** until surgical or interventional definitive

### Side effects
- **Apnea** (10-12 % — common, often within first 24 h)
- Fever
- Cutaneous flushing
- Hypotension
- Cortical hyperostosis (long-term)
- Gastric outlet obstruction (chronic)

### Pre-op management
- **CCHD pulse ox** + echo confirms diagnosis
- **PGE1 IV** (central preferred — peripheral may extravasate)
- Avoid > 30 % O₂ (closes PDA)
- Maintain SpO₂ 75-85 % для balanced circulation (HLHS)
- Avoid acidosis, hypoxia
- Limit fluid bolus (cardiac volume overload)
- ABX coverage if any sepsis suspect
- Consult pediatric cardiology + cardiac surgery

## Common neonatal surgeries

### HLHS (Hypoplastic Left Heart Syndrome)

#### Norwood I procedure (week 1)
- Atrial septectomy
- DKS (Damus-Kaye-Stansel) anastomosis (proximal pulmonary artery + aorta)
- BT shunt (Blalock-Taussig — provides pulmonary blood flow)
- ИЛИ Sano shunt (RV-to-PA conduit)
- Mortality 10-20 %

#### Glenn (4-6 months)
- BCPC (bidirectional cavopulmonary connection)
- SVC → PA
- Removes BT shunt

#### Fontan (2-4 years)
- IVC → PA (extracardiac или lateral tunnel)
- Final palliation
- Survival к adulthood ~70 %

### TGA (Transposition of Great Arteries)

#### Arterial switch (Jatene)
- Performed days 5-10 of life
- Switch aorta + PA + reimplant coronary arteries
- 95 % survival; near-normal heart function long-term
- Pre-op: BAS (balloon atrial septostomy — Rashkind) если restrictive PFO

### TOF (Tetralogy of Fallot)
- Complete repair 4-6 months age (NOT neonatal)
- Neonatal palliation: BT shunt only если cyanotic spell unresponsive medical therapy

### Coarctation aortae
- End-to-end resection с anastomosis
- Subclavian flap technique
- Performed once stabilized с PGE1

### TAPVR (Total Anomalous Pulmonary Venous Return)
- Anastomosis pulmonary venous confluence к LA
- Emergent if obstructed (high mortality)

## Cardiopulmonary bypass (CPB) effects

- Inflammatory response (capillary leak, edema)
- Coagulopathy (heparin → protamine reversal)
- Thrombocytopenia
- Renal dysfunction (AKI common)
- Pulmonary dysfunction (ALI/ARDS)
- Neurological — стандарт NIRS monitoring

## Post-op care

### Low cardiac output syndrome (LCOS)

#### Definition
- HR ≥ 180 + capillary refill > 3 sec + lactate > 4 + low UO

#### Pathophysiology
- Stunned myocardium post-CPB
- Ischemia-reperfusion injury
- Inflammatory response

#### Treatment
- **Milrinone** 0.25-0.75 мкг/кг/мин (PRIMACORP trial 2003 — preventive)
- **Dopamine** 5-10 мкг/кг/мин (β1 inotropic dose)
- **Epinephrine** 0.05-0.3 мкг/кг/мин
- **Levosimendan** при refractory (calcium sensitizer)
- **Vasopressin** 0.0001-0.001 ед/кг/мин (catecholamine-resistant)
- **Steroid** stress dose (hydrocortisone 1 мг/кг q8-12h)

### Other complications
- **Pulmonary hypertension crisis** — iNO, sedation, paralysis, hyperventilation
- **Tamponade** — chest tube output sudden ↓ + signs shock
- **Arrhythmias** — JET (junctional ectopic tachycardia) common; treat с amiodarone, magnesium
- **AKI** — fluid overload monitoring; CRRT if needed
- **Chylothorax** (rare) — chest tube + low-fat diet (MCT-based) или TPN; somatostatin/octreotide if refractory

## Monitoring tools

- **NIRS (Near-Infrared Spectroscopy)** — cerebral + somatic O₂ saturation
- **CVP, arterial line** — continuous
- **Echo** — daily contractility, valve function
- **Lactate** — q2-4h
- **Urine output** — q1h

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-alprostadil-dose (PGE1)
- neo-milrinone-dose, neo-epinephrine-infusion, neo-dopamine-dose, neo-norepinephrine-dose, neo-vasopressin-dose, neo-levosimendan-dose, neo-hydrocortisone-dose
- neo-tof-spell-management
- neo-cchd-pulse-oximetry

## Источники

- Hoffman TM et al. Circulation 2003;107:996 — PRIMACORP milrinone
- Newburger JW et al. Pediatrics 2010;125:e810 — HLHS outcomes
- AHA Scientific Statement 2018 — Single Ventricle Care
- Sano S et al. J Thorac Cardiovasc Surg 2003;126:504 — Sano shunt
- Society of Thoracic Surgeons CHSS database

articles.summary: Bell IIIB — laparotomy + resection + enterostomy. Reversal через 6-12 нед. Short bowel syndrome — TPN dependence + длительная gut adaptation.
articles.content:
## Indications surgery в NEC

### Absolute
- **Pneumoperitoneum** (free air on radiograph) — perforation
- **Persistent metabolic acidosis** не отвечающий на medical management
- **Fixed dilated bowel loop** persistent on serial CXR (sentinel loop)
- **Severe systemic deterioration** (DIC, hypotension, multi-organ failure)

### Relative
- **Portal venous gas + clinical deterioration**
- **Failure progress на medical NEC management** (Bell IIIA)
- **Stricture later** (после medical NEC) — elective

## Initial surgical option у extreme preterm

### Peritoneal drainage (Moss 2006 NEJM)
- Bedside placement Penrose drain
- For ELBW < 1000 g if too unstable for laparotomy
- Allows decompression + drainage perforation
- Some infants stabilize без further surgery (~30 %)
- НЕ definitive — most require subsequent laparotomy

### Laparotomy
- Standard approach for stable infants
- Direct visualization + resection + stoma

## Operative technique

### Bowel resection
- Resect grossly necrotic bowel
- Preserve as much viable bowel as possible (avoid SBS)
- Question equivocal viability — second-look 24-48 h после

### Enterostomy (stoma)
- **Jejunostomy** (proximal — high output)
- **Ileostomy** (мid-distal — most common)
- **Colostomy** (rare, only descending colon NEC)

### Mucous fistula или Hartmann pouch
- Closure distal limb to maintain continuity later

### "Clip-and-drop" technique
- Multiple bowel discontinuity points clipped
- Re-explore 24-48 h later
- Allows preservation marginally viable bowel

## Stoma care

### Initial
- Open immediately post-op
- Clear output (serosanguinous → bilious)
- Volume replacement: 1:1 mL output replacement initially (Plasma-Lyte or D5/0.45 NaCl with K)
- Adjust based on Na, K, acid-base status

### Ongoing
- Output 30-50 мл/кг/d typical for ileostomy
- Skin protection (barrier ring, ostomy bag)
- Volume + electrolyte monitoring
- Regular weighing

### High-output (> 50 мл/кг/d)
- Loperamide 0.1 мг/кг q6h
- Cholestyramine 0.25 г/кг q6h
- Octreotide 1-10 мкг/кг/d (refractory)

## Reanastomosis (closure)

### Timing
- Typically 6-12 weeks after initial surgery
- Once infant stable + grown
- Typically ≥ 2 кг weight
- Distal limb assessed по contrast study (no stricture)

### Procedure
- End-to-end или side-to-side anastomosis
- Preserve length всё possible

## Short Bowel Syndrome (SBS)

### Definition
- < 25 % expected bowel length для age
- Term newborn: < 75 cm
- Preterm: < 25 cm IS (intestinal salvage)

### Classifications
- **Type 1:** end-jejunostomy (no colon)
- **Type 2:** jejunoileostomy + partial colon
- **Type 3:** end-ileostomy + colon (best prognosis)

### Management

#### Acute phase (immediate post-resection)
- TPN (central line)
- Bowel rest + gradual enteral introduction
- Monitor for cholestasis (PNALD)

#### Adaptation phase (months — years)
- Slow enteral advancement
- Continuous low-rate feeds preferred (better absorption)
- Hydrolyzed formula (Pregestimil, Alimentum) или amino acid (Neocate, EleCare)
- Avoid bolus feeds initially

#### Long-term
- Wean TPN as enteral tolerated
- Multivitamins, B12 (если ileal resection > 60 cm), iron, Ca, Mg
- Glucagon-like peptide-2 analogs (Teduglutide) — newer для adapting bowel
- Intestinal transplant — last resort

### Outcomes SBS
- 50-70 % achieve enteral autonomy с modern care
- 30-50 % long-term TPN dependence
- 10-15 % require intestinal transplant
- Mortality: PNALD-related liver failure most common

## Cholestasis prevention (PNALD)

- **SMOFlipid** vs pure soybean (intralipid) — ↓ PNALD risk
- **Trophic feeds** as soon as possible (10-20 мл/кг/d)
- **Cycling lipids** 8-12 ч/d break
- **Sepsis prevention bundles** (CRBSI rates < 1 / 1000 catheter days)
- **Ursodeoxycholic acid** 10 мг/кг q12h при cholestasis
- **Fish oil rescue** (Omegaven) для refractory PNALD

- neo-fluid
- neo-enteral
- neo-loperamide-dose
- neo-octreotide-dose
- neo-bell-nec

## Источники

- Moss RL et al. NEJM 2006;354:2225 — Drain vs laparotomy
- AAP COFN. Pediatrics 2024 — NEC consensus
- Cole CR et al. Pediatrics 2008;122:e573 — SBS outcomes
- Lapillonne A et al. JPGN 2018;67:419 — SMOFlipid evidence
- Squires RH et al. J Pediatr 2012;161:723 — Pediatric SBS
- Kocoshis SA. Curr Opin Gastroenterol 2010 — Adaptation
