articles.summary: Antenatal: betamethasone 12 мг IM × 2 q24h при threatened preterm 24-34 нед. MgSO4 neuroprotection < 32 нед. Postnatal: CPAP first, LISA когда FiO2 > 0.30.
articles.content:
## Antenatal protocols

### Antenatal corticosteroids (ACS)

#### Indications
- Threatened preterm labor 24-34 нед gestation
- ROM с probable preterm delivery 24-34 нед
- Pregnancy с indications для elective delivery 34-36+6 нед (late preterm — ALPS trial 2016)

#### Schemes
- **Betamethasone:** 12 мг IM × 2 doses q24h (preferred — longer t½)
- **Dexamethasone:** 6 мг IM × 4 doses q12h (alternative)

#### Effects
- Maximum effect: 48 ч после first dose
- Partial effect: после first dose
- Persists ~7 d
- Repeat course ("rescue") 7+ d after initial если ongoing risk: ↓ severe RDS

#### Outcomes (Roberts Cochrane 2017)
- ↓ Mortality (30 % reduction)
- ↓ RDS (44 % reduction)
- ↓ IVH (46 % reduction)
- ↓ NEC (50 % reduction)
- ↓ Need MV

#### Caveats
- Late preterm (34-36+6 нед, ALPS 2016): ↑ neonatal hypoglycemia
- Repeat courses у extreme preterm: small ↓ birthweight, ↓ HC — uncertain long-term

### MgSO₄ neuroprotection

#### Indications
- Threatened preterm < 32 нед в течение 24 ч delivery
- Crowther Cochrane 2017: ↓ CP risk 30 %

#### Doses
- Loading: 4-6 г IV over 30 мин
- Maintenance: 1-2 г/ч IV until delivery (max 24 ч)

### Antibiotics maternal

#### Preterm ROM (PROM)
- Latency antibiotics — Mercer's regimen:
  - Ampicillin 2 г IV q6h × 48 h, then amoxicillin PO 250 мг q8h × 5 days
  - Plus erythromycin 250 мг IV q6h × 48 h, then PO × 5 days
- ↓ Maternal chorio, ↓ neonatal infection, ↑ latency

#### GBS prophylaxis
- All pregnancies screened 36-37 нед
- Positive: penicillin G 5 миллион ед IV at labor + 2.5 миллион ед q4h until delivery
- Penicillin allergy + low risk anaphylaxis: cefazolin 2 г IV → 1 г q8h
- Penicillin allergy + high risk anaphylaxis: clindamycin 900 мг q8h (if susceptible) или vancomycin

## Delivery room

### Cord management
- **DCC (delayed cord clamping)** ≥ 60 sec для term + most preterms (АAP 2017)
- **UCM (umbilical cord milking)** — alternative когда DCC contraindicated; **AVOID < 28 нед** (ELOVATE 2020 ↑ IVH risk)

### Initial assessment
- Term + tone + breathing/crying → routine care
- Compromised → warmer + dry + stimulate + position

### CPAP first
- Start CPAP сразу при stable cardiac (NRP 8 ed.)
- PEEP 5-7 см H₂O
- FiO₂ 21 % term, 21-30 % preterm
- Goal SpO₂ minute-of-life curve (NRP)

### Surfactant indications
- < 28 нед PMA + FiO₂ > 0.30 на CPAP
- 28-32 нед PMA + FiO₂ > 0.40
- ≥ 32 нед PMA + FiO₂ > 0.50 (RDS)

### Surfactant administration — LISA preferred
- **Poractant 200 мг/кг** first dose (preferred over beractant — Cochrane 2015)
- **LISA technique** — thin catheter без extubation (Aldana-Aguirre 2021)
- Monitor SpO₂, HR during + after

## NICU ventilation

### CPAP / NIV
- Continuous CPAP first-line 5-7 см H₂O
- High-flow nasal cannula (HFNC) — alternative; less effective in severe RDS
- BiPAP / NIPPV — alternatives когда CPAP failure

### MV (когда CPAP failure)
- **Volume-targeted ventilation (VTV)** preferred (Cochrane 2017 — ↓ BPD)
- Tidal volume 4-6 мл/кг
- Permissive hypercapnia 45-55 (pH > 7.25)
- Permissive hypoxemia SpO₂ 90-95 % (NeOProM 2018)
- Synchronization preferred (SIMV или PSV)

### HFOV — escalation
- Refractory hypoxemia
- Air leak syndromes
- Severe MAS

## Caffeine citrate

### Start
- ≤ 3 days жизни (early start)
- All preterm < 32 нед

### Doses
- Loading: 20 мг/кг IV / PO
- Maintenance: 5-10 мг/кг q24h

### Effects (CAP trial Schmidt 2007)
- ↓ BPD (36 % vs 47 %)
- ↓ MV duration
- ↓ ROP requiring treatment
- ↓ Cerebral palsy (long-term follow-up)

### Stop
- Apnea-free × 5-7 дней
- ≥ 34 нед PMA

| Stage | SCr criteria | Urine output |
|---|---|---|
| **0** | < 0.3 mg/dL ↑ from baseline | > 0.5 mL/kg/h × 6 h |
| **1** | ↑ ≥ 0.3 mg/dL OR 1.5-1.9× baseline | < 0.5 mL/kg/h × 6-12 h |
| **2** | 2.0-2.9× baseline | < 0.5 mL/kg/h × ≥ 12 h |
| **3** | ≥ 3× baseline OR ≥ 2.5 mg/dL OR dialysis | < 0.3 mL/kg/h × ≥ 24 h OR anuria × ≥ 12 h |

### Caveats у newborn
- Maternal Cr equilibrates в первые 7-10 d
- Преtermin baseline Cr higher
- Glomerular filtration matures постепенно (40 % adult level at term)

## Эпидемиология (AWAKEN 2017)

Neonatal AWAKEN multi-center study (Jetton JG et al, Lancet Child Adolesc Health):
- AKI у 29.9 % all NICU admissions
- Highest incidence (47 %) у GA 22-29 нед
- AKI ↑ mortality 2-4x
- AKI ↑ length of stay 2x

## Risk factors

### Maternal / antenatal
- Maternal HTN / preeclampsia
- IUGR
- Maternal NSAIDs (low Doppler), ACE-i
- Maternal cocaine

### Neonatal
- **Asphyxia / HIE** (most common — pre-renal)
- Sepsis
- Cardiac surgery
- ECMO
- Nephrotoxic drugs (gentamicin, vancomycin, amphotericin B, indomethacin, ibuprofen, ACE-i)
- Severe RDS / MV
- ELBW (immature renal function)
- Congenital anomalies (CAKUT)

## Categorii

### Pre-renal (most common у newborn)
- Volume depletion / dehydration
- Hypotension / hypoxic injury
- Heart failure (pre-cardiac)
- ECMO

### Intrinsic
- ATN (acute tubular necrosis) — ischemic / toxic
- Drugs nephrotoxicity
- Sepsis
- DIC (cortical necrosis)
- HIE / asphyxia
- Renal vein thrombosis

### Post-renal (rare у newborn)
- Posterior urethral valves (PUV — boys)
- Bilateral hydronephrosis (CAKUT)
- Neurogenic bladder

## Диагностика

### Clinical
- Oliguria / anuria
- Edema
- Hypertension (volume overload)
- Failure to thrive

### Lab
- **Serum Cr** + BUN (trend)
- **Cystatin C** — alternative biomarker (less affected by maternal/muscle mass)
- **Urine sodium** + FENa (helps differentiate pre-renal vs intrinsic)
  - **Pre-renal:** FENa < 1 % (term), < 2.5 % (preterm)
  - **Intrinsic ATN:** FENa > 2.5 % (term), > 6 % (preterm)
- **Urinalysis:** RBC casts (glomerular), WBC casts (interstitial), granular casts (ATN)
- **Renal US** — exclude obstruction; assess size, parenchymal echogenicity
- **Voiding cystourethrogram (VCUG)** if obstruction suspected

## Treatment

### Pre-renal
- **Fluid resuscitation** 10-20 мл/кг NS если volume depleted (cautious — НЕ overload)
- **Inotropes** для cardiac dysfunction
- **PRBC** transfusion если anemia + hypovolemia

### Intrinsic
- **Optimize hemodynamics** — MAP > 50, adequate perfusion
- **Discontinue nephrotoxic drugs** (gentamicin, vanco, ibuprofen, ACE-i)
- **Adjust drug doses** для CrCl (особенно vancomycin, gentamicin — extended interval)
- **Avoid further insults** (hypotension, hypoxia, contrast dye if possible)

### Fluid management
- **Insensible water losses** + UO + GI loss replacement
- НЕ "maintenance" rate когда oliguric (overload risk)
- **Furosemide trial** 1-2 мг/кг IV — может increase UO в transient AKI
  - НЕ improve outcomes (Cochrane 2014)
  - Useful только для symptomatic volume overload

### Hyperkalemia
- Insulin + glucose, calcium gluconate, kayexalate
- См. art-electrolytes для full algorithm

### Renal Replacement Therapy (RRT)

#### Indications
- **Severe volume overload** unresponsive к diuretics
- **Refractory hyperkalemia** (K > 7 + ECG changes)
- **Severe acidosis** (pH < 7.1) unresponsive к bicarbonate
- **Uremia symptomatic** (encephalopathy, pericarditis)
- **Hyperammonemia > 500 µмоль/л** (IEM)

#### Modalities (по preference у newborn)
- **Peritoneal dialysis (PD)** — preferred — bedside, gentle, no anticoagulation
- **CRRT (continuous renal replacement)** — newer pediatric machines (CARPEDIEM, NIDUS) для < 10 кг
- **HD (intermittent)** — mainly older children

## Outcomes

### Short-term
- AKI ↑ NICU LOS, mortality
- Recovery 65-85 % survivors

### Long-term
- ↑ Risk CKD, hypertension, proteinuria
- AKI у preterm — ↑ adult cardiovascular disease (Barker hypothesis)
- Follow-up nephrology до 5+ year recommended

- neo-cagluconate-dose
- neo-insulin-dose

- Askenazi DJ et al. J Pediatr 2013;162:725 — Risk factors
- Coleman C et al. Pediatr Nephrol 2018;33:2435 — Long-term outcomes
- Selewski DT et al. Lancet 2018;391:e6 — RRT consensus

articles.summary: Vernix preserve. Bath delay 6-24 h term, не bathing у preterm. Chlorhexidine cord care в endemic. Common infections: candida, omphalitis, S.aureus.
articles.content:
## Skin physiology newborn

### Term
- Stratum corneum — immature первые 2-4 недели
- Vernix caseosa — natural protective coating
- Acid mantle (pH 5.5) — establishes 1-4 нед жизни
- Drying / desquamation у post-term — normal

### Preterm
- Stratum corneum значительно immature
- Translucent skin (visible vessels)
- High transepidermal water loss (TEWL)
- Skin barrier восстанавливается медленнее (4-8 недель в ELBW)
- ↑ Risk percutaneous absorption topicals

## Bath / hygiene

### Term
- **Delay bath ≥ 6 h** (WHO рекомендует ≥ 24 h)
- Preserve vernix — antimicrobial properties + insulation
- Lower hypothermia risk
- Sponge bath until cord stump heals (1-2 нед)
- Then routine bath 2-3 раза/нед
- Plain warm water OR mild non-medicated soap
- НЕ ежедневные baths (dries skin)

### Preterm < 32 нед
- **Avoid bathing** в первые 1-2 недели
- Spot-clean только
- Humidified incubator (60-80 % humidity у ELBW first 7 d)
- Once stable + skin matured: gentle sponge bath с warm water

## Cord care

### Approaches
- **Dry cord care (developed countries)** — standard. Air-dry, no antiseptic. WHO 2017
- **Chlorhexidine 4 % gluconate cord care (endemic / high-mortality)** — single application 0.5-1 ml; ↓ omphalitis + neonatal mortality в LMICs (Imdad 2013 Cochrane)

### Stump care
- Keep dry
- Fold diaper below stump
- Falls off 5-15 d
- Granuloma persisting > 4 недель — silver nitrate cauterization (1 application)

### Omphalitis (P38)
- Erythema > 5 mm extending от cord
- Purulent discharge
- Fever, sepsis signs
- Treatment:
  - Cellulitis local: oxacillin + gentamicin IV
  - Severe (extending erythema, fever): vancomycin + gentamicin
  - Necrotizing fasciitis (rare): aggressive surgical debridement + ICU support
  - Mortality 7-15 % если spreads

## Common skin findings — physiological

### Erythema toxicum neonatorum
- 30-70 % term newborns
- Yellow-white pustules на erythematous base
- Eosinophil-rich on cytology
- Self-resolves 5-7 d
- НЕ treatment

### Milia
- 40-50 % newborns
- White papules на nose, cheeks
- Self-resolves few weeks
- НЕ squeeze (scarring risk)

### Mongolian spots (sacral patches, common in Asian, African, Latin American populations)
- Blue-grey pigmentation
- Often sacrum, buttocks, back
- НЕ ассоциированы с child abuse — physiological
- Resolve to 2-5 yr

### Stork bite (telangiectatic nevus)
- Salmon patch on neck, eyelids
- Self-resolves к 1 yr (eyelids); permanent on neck

### Sebaceous hyperplasia
- Yellow papules nose/forehead
- Self-resolves 4-6 нед

### Sucking blisters
- Lip / dorsum of hand vesicles
- Self-resolves

## Common skin infections

### Candidiasis

#### Mucocutaneous (thrush, diaper rash)
- Common — 50 % newborns at some point
- Treatment:
  - Oral: nystatin 100,000 ед q6h × 7-14 d
  - Diaper: topical nystatin / clotrimazole

#### Invasive (sepsis-like)
- ELBW + central line + TPN — classic risks
- Treatment: fluconazole 12 мг/кг q24h × 14-21 d minimum

### S. aureus (impetigo, pustulosis)
- Yellow / honey-crusted lesions
- Vesicles → pustules
- Treatment:
  - Localized: mupirocin topical
  - Disseminated / sepsis: vancomycin (MRSA suspect) или oxacillin (MSSA)

### HSV vesicles
- See art-hsv
- High suspicion for grouped vesicles в newborn
- ANY vesicular rash → workup для HSV (ПЦР CSF + skin lesion)

### Eosinophilic pustulosis
- Diaper area, scalp
- Self-resolves 3-12 мес
- Mild topical steroid если symptomatic

## Diaper rash

### Categorii
- **Irritant contact** (most common — urine, stool)
- **Candida diaper rash** (satellite lesions)
- **Seborrheic** (oily scales — also scalp)
- **Atopic** (xerotic, family history)

### Prevention
- Frequent diaper changes (q1-2h newborn)
- Air-dry время
- Barrier cream (zinc oxide, petrolatum)
- НЕ baby powder (talc — aspiration risk)

### Treatment
- Severe irritant: zinc oxide 40 % paste, hydrocortisone 1 % × 5-7 d
- Candida: nystatin / clotrimazole topical 7-14 d
- Severe: pediatric dermatology referral

## Topical agents — caution

- **Hexachlorophene** — neurotoxic (banned для routine use)
- **Iodine antiseptics** — absorbed → hypothyroidism у newborn (avoid)
- **Boric acid** — toxicity (banned)
- **Phenol-based** — methemoglobinemia
- **Chlorhexidine** — preferred antiseptic для procedures

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-nystatin-dose
- neo-fluconazole-dose
- neo-vancomycin-dose
- neo-perinatal-infections-class (omphalitis P38)

## Источники

- WHO. Postnatal Care Guidelines 2022
- Imdad A et al. Cochrane 2013:CD009741 — Chlorhexidine cord care
- AAP / AWHONN. Neonatal Skin Care 4th ed. 2018
- O'Connor NR et al. Am Fam Physician 2008;77:47 — Newborn skin disorders

articles.summary: NIDCAP, kangaroo care, минимизация шума/света, синхронизированный sleep, контейнментв. Improves NDI outcomes (Cochrane 2020).
articles.content:
## Концепции

Developmental care — мультикомпонентный подход для оптимизации neurodevelopmental outcomes у preterm + sick newborns. Цель: minimize iatrogenic stress + facilitate family-centered care + support brain development.

## Главные принципы

### 1. Optimal positioning
- **Containment / facilitated tucking** — fetal-like flexed position
- Side-lying, prone, supine alternating
- Boundaries / nests (rolled blankets) — feeling of containment
- Avoid prolonged supine flat position
- Skin-to-skin (kangaroo) — gold standard

### 2. Minimize sensory overload

#### Light
- Cycled lighting (day/night) — 10-14 h light, 10-12 h dim
- Cover incubators при rest
- Procedures — task lighting, avoid full overhead lights
- WHO recommend ≤ 600 lux in NICU; cycled lighting preferred

#### Sound
- WHO recommend ≤ 45 dB ambient
- НЕ talking over incubator
- Soft-close drawers / equipment
- Avoid alarms unnecessarily loud
- Talking, gentle music — within rocker chair / kangaroo session

#### Tactile
- Slow, gentle movements
- Predictable cluster care
- Avoid sudden stimulation
- Pacifier / non-nutritive sucking — comfort

### 3. Sleep cycle protection
- **Cluster care** — group interventions to allow uninterrupted sleep
- Long sleep periods (60-90 мин) ideally
- Avoid awakening для non-essential checks
- Synchronization с natural circadian (cycled lighting helps)

### 4. Pain management
See art-pain (tiered approach).

### 5. Family-centered care
- **Open visiting hours** (24/7 ideally)
- **Kangaroo mother care** — early, prolonged sessions
- **Breastfeeding support** — lactation consultants
- **Parent education** — empowerment for home care
- **Sibling visits** (with infection control)
- **Bereavement support** — for loss / palliative care

## NIDCAP (Newborn Individualized Developmental Care and Assessment Program)

### Concept
- Heidelise Als et al. (Boston) 1980s
- Trained NIDCAP-specialists observe + score behavioural cues
- Individualized care plan based on observed self-regulation strategies

### Domains assessed
- Autonomic (color, breathing, jitters)
- Motor (tone, posture, movement)
- Behavioral state (sleep, awake)
- Attention / interaction
- Self-regulation

### Outcomes
- Cochrane 2020 (Symington A): improved neurobehavioral outcomes; ↓ MV duration; ↓ length stay
- Implementation требует training всего штаба

## Kangaroo Mother Care (KMC)

### Definition
Skin-to-skin contact between newborn (only diaper) и parental chest, ideally:
- ≥ 1 ч continuous sessions
- Several sessions / day
- Begin as soon as медицински stable (даже ELBW в incubator)

### Outcomes (WHO 2022)
- ↓ Mortality (LMICs ↓ 36 %; HICs ↓ ~10 %)
- ↓ Severe infections / sepsis
- ↓ Hypothermia
- ↑ Breastfeeding rates
- Improved bonding
- ↑ Weight gain
- Improved long-term neurodev

### Immediate KMC (iKMC) — newest evidence
- WHO Immediate KMC Study Group 2021 (NEJM): KMC начинается в первые 1 ч жизни даже у unstable preterm
- ↓ Mortality 25 % vs delayed KMC (when stable)
- Paradigm shift — challenges old practice of "stabilize first"

## Music therapy

### Methods
- Live music (singing, gentle instruments)
- Recorded music (lullabies, ambient)
- Heartbeat sounds (mother)
- Womb sounds simulation

### Benefits
- ↓ Pain during procedures
- ↓ Stress hormones
- Improved feeding behaviour
- Stabilization of vital signs

## Massage / touch therapy

### Yakson method (Korean origin)
- Gentle stroking + light pressure
- Sessions 15-30 min
- ↓ Stress, improved sleep, weight gain

### Field's pediatric massage
- Light pressure massage 3x/day
- Improved weight gain
- ↑ Vagal tone

## Cycled feeding

### Cue-based feeding (preterm)
- Feed when infant shows hunger cues (rooting, hand-to-mouth, alertness)
- НЕ rigid schedule — disrupts sleep
- Improves transition to oral feeding

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-thermal-management
- neo-feeding-readiness
- neo-pipp-r, neo-nips, neo-npass (pain assessment)

## Источники

- Symington A, Pinelli J. Cochrane 2020:CD001814 — NIDCAP
- WHO. Kangaroo Mother Care Guidelines 2022
- WHO Immediate KMC Study Group. NEJM 2021;384:2028
- Als H et al. Pediatrics 2004;113:846 — NIDCAP outcomes
- AAP COFN. Pediatrics 2024 — Family-centered care
- Conde-Agudelo A, Diaz-Rossello JL. Cochrane 2016:CD002771 — KMC outcomes

articles.title_ru: Палliативная и end-of-life care в NICU
articles.summary: Concurrent palliative care с life-prolonging therapy (AAP 2013). Comfort care: morphine + scopolamine. Family-centered approach. Bereavement support.
articles.content:
## Когда вспомнить о палliative care

### Triggers
- Lethal congenital anomaly (Trisomy 13, 18; bilateral renal agenesis, etc.)
- Severe HIE с poor prognosis
- Extreme prematurity < 22-23 нед ("limit of viability")
- Refractory critical illness (e.g., ECMO failure)
- Multi-organ failure not responding к treatment
- Family-initiated discussions

### Model — concurrent (AAP 2013)

NOT "either/or." Concurrent с life-prolonging therapy:
- Comfort + symptom management
- Family-centered communication
- Decision support
- Bereavement support
- Continuation if condition improves

## Communication framework

### Best practice — multi-disciplinary family meetings
- Neonatologist
- Bedside nurse
- Social worker
- Chaplain (if requested)
- Palliative care specialist (if consulted)
- Translator (if needed)

### Spikes protocol
- **S — Setting** (private room, sit, family supported)
- **P — Perception** (assess what family understands)
- **I — Invitation** (ask what info family wants)
- **K — Knowledge** (share clearly, slowly, jargon-free)
- **E — Emotions** (acknowledge, allow time)
- **S — Strategy / Summary** (next steps, plan)

### Honest prognostication
- Use specific numbers when possible ("50-70% chance of death")
- Acknowledge uncertainty
- Avoid technical jargon
- Multiple meetings — info absorbed gradually

## Decision-making framework

### Best interest standard
- Guide ethical decisions when family unsure
- Balance benefits vs burdens of intervention

### Common pediatric ethical questions
- Withdrawal vs withholding life-sustaining treatment
- Organ donation после circulatory death
- Тrial of therapy с pre-specified endpoints

### Practical considerations
- **MAUDE form (Medical Authorization)** — informed consent palliative redirection
- **Code status orders** — DNR, comfort-only, etc. (clearly documented)
- **Hospice referral** if home palliative possible

## Comfort symptoms management

### Pain / distress
- **Morphine** 50-100 мкг/кг IV q3-4h prn (or continuous 10-30 мкг/кг/h)
- **Fentanyl** 1-3 мкг/кг IV (for procedural)
- **Acetaminophen** 7.5-10 мг/кг q6h (mild)
- НЕ концентрироваться на specific opiates до titrate; use whatever effective

### Respiratory distress / dyspnea
- Morphine reduces sensation of dyspnea (low dose effective)
- Position upright, fan, calm environment
- Avoid CPAP / MV если comfort-only goal

### Secretions / "death rattle"
- Glycopyrrolate 4-10 мкг/кг q4-6h IV
- Scopolamine patch (1.5 мг patch) — applies retroauricular
- Suction только if causing distress (gentle, brief)

### Seizures
- Phenobarbital 20 мг/кг IV loading
- Levetiracetam 40-100 мг/кг IV
- Lorazepam 0.05-0.1 мг/кг IV/PR (rescue)

### Agitation / restlessness
- Midazolam 0.05-0.15 мг/кг IV bolus or 0.06-0.4 мг/кг/h infusion
- Clonidine 0.5-2 мкг/кг/h IV

### GI symptoms
- Anti-emetics (ondansetron 0.1 мг/кг — short-term)
- Constipation prevention (rectal glycerine if NPO)

## Withdrawal of mechanical ventilation

### Preparation
- Family present (preferred — ideally holding the infant skin-to-skin)
- Comfort medications pre-loaded (morphine + sedation)
- Bedside private (curtains, low lights, no interruptions)
- Medical witness for documentation

### Procedure
1. Bolus morphine 100-200 мкг/кг + midazolam 100-200 мкг/кг IV
2. ETT removed gently
3. Continue comfort meds prn
4. Stay с family
5. Document time of death (apnea + asystole + non-reactive pupils)

## After death — care

### Immediate
- Validate parent emotions
- Allow private time
- Bathing / dressing infant — family preference
- Photographs (free legacy services available — "Now I Lay Me Down to Sleep")
- Hand / foot prints, hair lock
- Personal mementos (blanket, ID band)

### Death certificate
- Cause of death по local regulations
- Genetic counseling если applicable
- Autopsy discussion (consent for limited or full)

### Bereavement follow-up
- Phone call 1-2 нед
- Letter at 1 month, 1 year (anniversary)
- Bereavement support groups
- Counseling referrals
- Special memorial events (annual NICU memorial service)

## Staff support

- Debriefings post-loss
- Counseling availability
- Memorial recognition
- Multidisciplinary team support

## Calculator Bordik
- neo-morphine-dose
- neo-fentanyl-dose
- neo-midazolam-dose
- neo-phenobarbital-dose
- neo-clonidine-dose
- neo-glycopyrrolate-dose

- AAP COFN, AAP Section on Hospice & Palliative Medicine. Pediatrics 2013;132:966 — Pediatric palliative care
- AAP. Pediatrics 2017;140:e20171905 — Palliative care for newborn
- WHO. Integrating Palliative Care into Pediatrics 2018
- Catlin A et al. J Perinatol 2002;22:184 — Neonatal end-of-life palliative care protocol

articles.content:
## Кому нужен high-risk follow-up

### Тарget population
- **VLBW < 1500 g** (especially ELBW < 1000 g)
- **GA < 32 нед**
- **HIE moderate-severe** (Sarnat II-III)
- **Severe IVH** (grade III-IV)
- **PVL** (periventricular leukomalacia)
- **NEC** (especially требующий surgery)
- **CHD repair**
- **Therapy ECMO**
- **Severe BPD** (требующий home O₂)
- **Confirmed cCMV / cTORCH**
- **Surgical neonatal admissions** (CDH, etc.)
- **NDI risk indicators** (e.g., abnormal MRI)

## Compoнents follow-up

### Pediatric primary care
- Usual primary care (vaccines, growth, etc.)
- Coordination с specialists
- Communication между NICU follow-up clinic + PCP

### Neurodevelopmental clinic
- Neonatologist / developmental pediatrician
- Physical, occupational, speech therapy
- Psychology / behavioral assessment
- Visits: 4 mo, 8 mo, 12 mo, 18-24 mo, 36 mo (some до school age)

### Subspecialty clinics
- **Pulmonology** (BPD, home O₂)
- **Cardiology** (CHD, PPHN, ECMO survivors)
- **GI / Nutrition** (SBS, TPN-dependent)
- **Nephrology** (AKI history, CAKUT)
- **Endocrinology** (hypothyroidism, growth, hypoglycemia)
- **Audiology** (hearing screening + diagnostic)
- **Ophthalmology** (ROP follow-up, refractive errors)
- **Genetics / metabolic** (IEM, syndromes)
- **Surgery** (post-op follow-up)
- **Neurology** (HIE, IVH, seizures)

## Schedule (recommended)

### 0-3 мес corrected age
- 1-2 нед post-discharge: pediatrician home visit
- 4-6 нед post-discharge: NICU follow-up clinic
- Hearing screen confirmed (если abnormal — diagnostic ABR)
- Ophthalmology если ROP screening continues
- Cardiology если PDA, PPHN, ECMO

### 3-6 мес corrected age
- Bayley screening (BINS — Brief Infant-Toddler Social and Emotional Assessment)
- Vaccines on chronological schedule
- Anthropometrics
- Pulmonology если BPD on O₂
- ROP follow-up (refraction)

### 6-12 мес corrected age
- **Bayley III screening** (limited)
- Hearing follow-up (especially cCMV, asphyxia, NICU > 5 d)
- Audiology re-evaluation если risk факторы

### 18-24 мес corrected age
- **Bayley III full** (cognitive, language, motor) — gold standard
- Modified Checklist for Autism in Toddlers (M-CHAT) если risk
- Vision assessment
- Speech therapy evaluation

### 3 yr corrected age
- Bayley III repeat (cognitive trajectory)
- Ages and Stages Questionnaire (ASQ-3)
- School readiness

### School-age (5-7 yr)
- Cognitive assessment (WPPSI-IV / WISC-V)
- Academic readiness
- Behaviour rating scales (BASC-3, CBCL)
- Continued ophthalmology + audiology прн

## Common issues followed

### Cognitive delays / learning disabilities
- 30-40 % VLBW
- 50 % ELBW
- Higher с severe IVH, PVL, severe HIE

### Language / speech delays
- 25-40 % VLBW
- More common с auditory deprivation (hearing loss)

### Cerebral palsy
- 7-15 % VLBW
- 50 % grade III-IV IVH
- Severe HIE: 30-50 % CP

### ADHD / behavioral
- 2-3x more common в preterm survivors

### Visual impairment
- ROP-related
- Cortical visual impairment (HIE, severe IVH)

### Hearing loss
- 1-3 % VLBW (vs 0.1-0.3 % term)
- ↑ Risk: NICU > 5 d, ECMO, asphyxia, cCMV, ototoxic drugs (gentamicin > 5 d)

### Growth
- EUGR (extrauterine growth restriction) у ELBW
- Catch-up growth most achieve by 2-3 yr
- 10-20 % continue с persistent growth restriction

### Asthma / chronic lung disease
- BPD survivors с ↑ asthma, RSV bronchiolitis, recurrent wheeze

## Early intervention

### Triggers
- Any development concern at follow-up
- Bayley scores < 1 SD
- Parent concerns

### Services (по region)
- Physical therapy
- Occupational therapy
- Speech therapy
- Special education preschool
- Family education

### Outcomes evidence
- Early intervention 0-3 yr improves cognitive, language, motor outcomes
- Mean effect size 0.3-0.5 SD
- Maximum benefit if started < 1 yr

articles.summary: UVC ≤ 7-14 d; PICC после. Tip position SVC/RA junction (preferred). Heparin flush. CRBSI bundle critical.
articles.content:
## UVC (Umbilical Venous Catheter)

### Indications
- Emergency vascular access (resuscitation)
- Central access первые 7 дней жизни
- TPN administration (high osmolarity > 900 мосм/л)
- Exchange transfusion

### Insertion + position
- Sterile technique
- Depth: (3 × BW kg) + 9 / 2 cm (Shukla)
- Tip position: above diaphragm at IVC/RA junction (T9-T10) preferred
- Confirm на CXR

### Removal
- ≤ 7-14 d (avoid CRBSI)
- Replace с PICC если longer access needed

## PICC (Peripherally Inserted Central Catheter)

### Indications
- Long-term TPN > 7-14 d
- IV antibiotics > 7 d
- Replacement of UVC после 7-14 d

### Insertion sites
- Cubital, basilic veins (most common)
- Saphenous, popliteal alternatives
- Scalp veins у preterm с small extremity vessels

### Catheter
- 1.9 Fr (single-lumen)
- 2 Fr (preferred)
- Polyurethane или silicone material

### Tip position
- **SVC** (superior vena cava) — preferred
- Lower 1/3 SVC ideal
- НЕ в right atrium (cardiac perforation risk)
- Confirm на CXR

### Maintenance
- Heparin flush 1-2 ед/мл (1 мл q12h)
- Continuous flush 0.5 мл/h в маленькой инфузии
- Sterile dressing change weekly
- Daily inspection — phlebitis, infiltration, leak

## CRBSI (Catheter-Related Bloodstream Infection) prevention

### Bundle (Pronovost-style)
1. **Hand hygiene** before touching catheter
2. **Maximal sterile barrier** при insertion (mask, cap, sterile gloves, sterile drape)
3. **Chlorhexidine 2 %** skin antiseptic
4. **Optimal site selection** (avoid femoral если возможно)
5. **Daily review necessity** + remove ASAP

### Outcomes
- CRBSI rate target < 1 / 1000 catheter days
- Reduces sepsis, mortality, NICU LOS

## Complications

### Mechanical
- Cardiac arrhythmias (катетер в RA)
- Cardiac perforation / tamponade (rare, but lethal)
- Vascular injury
- Thrombosis (catheter-related)
- Pleural / pericardial effusion
- Catheter migration / dislodgement

### Infectious
- CRBSI (S. aureus, CoNS, GNR, Candida)
- Local site infection
- Endocarditis (rare)

### Thrombosis treatment
- Catheter clearance: alteplase 0.5-2 мг intra-luminal × 30-120 мин dwell, attempt aspirate
- If clot in vessel: anticoagulation (heparin / LMWH)

articles.summary: Acute deterioration на MV: D-O-P-E mnemonic. Displacement, Obstruction, Pneumothorax, Equipment failure.
articles.content:
## DOPE мнемоника

Используется при acute deterioration новорождённого на mechanical ventilation.

### D — Displacement (ETT смещение)
- Дисlodgement из trachea (extubation accidental)
- Endobronchial intubation (R main bronchus most common)
- ETT слишком высоко (cord level)

**Признаки:**
- Asymmetric chest expansion
- Decreased breath sounds одной стороны
- ETCO₂ drop
- Sudden hypoxemia + bradycardia

**Action:**
- Listen breath sounds bilaterally
- Check ETT depth (compare с last documented)
- CXR if ambiguous
- Re-intubate if extubated

### O — Obstruction (ETT блокада)
- Mucus plug
- Kinked ETT
- Patient biting / gagging (older infants)
- Blood clot

**Признаки:**
- ↑ Peak inspiratory pressure (PIP) on volume-targeted vent
- ↓ Tidal volume on pressure-controlled vent
- Audible wheeze / no air movement
- ETCO₂ drop

**Action:**
- Suction ETT
- Disconnect + bag-ventilate (assess if obstruction в circuit или ETT)
- Replace ETT if obstructed

### P — Pneumothorax
- Sudden onset; tension PTX в worst case

**Признаки:**
- Asymmetric chest expansion (decreased on PTX side)
- Decreased breath sounds + hyperresonance affected side
- Mediastinal shift (heart sounds shifted)
- Hypotension, bradycardia в tension PTX
- Transillumination positive (cool light)

**Action:**
- Transillumination test bedside
- Needle decompression если tension (2nd intercostal space, midclav)
- Chest tube для definitive
- CXR confirmation

### E — Equipment failure
- Vent malfunction
- Disconnection circuit
- Power failure
- O₂ supply failure
- Flowmeter / sensor error

**Признаки:**
- Vent alarms (low pressure, low minute volume)
- Visual inspection — check connections, settings, gas supply

**Action:**
- Disconnect from vent
- Bag-mask или T-piece manual ventilation
- Identify problem (try different vent / circuit)
- Replace component

## Algorithm

```
Acute deterioration → 
  1. Bag-ventilate + 100 % O₂ + observe
  2. Listen breath sounds bilaterally
  3. Check ETT position (depth, color, ETCO₂)
  4. Auscultate / transilluminate (PTX?)
  5. Suction ETT (clear obstruction?)
  6. CXR if not resolved
  7. Consider needle decompression (tension PTX)
  8. Re-intubate если ETT issue
  9. Equipment check / replace if exhausted other causes
```

articles.summary: Direct bilirubin > 1 мг/дл — workup. Biliary atresia — emergency (Kasai к 60 d). UDCA + medium-chain fat formula support.
articles.content:
## Definition

- **Cholestasis:** direct bilirubin > 17 µмоль/л (1 мг/дл) ИЛИ > 20 % total bilirubin
- Persistent > 14 d жизни — workup
- Pathological — never physiological

## Causes

### 1. Obstructive — most urgent
- **Biliary atresia (BA)** — leading cause; Kasai operation by 60 d жизни critical для outcome
- Choledochal cyst
- Inspissated bile syndrome
- Cystic fibrosis (meconium ileus)

### 2. Infectious
- TORCH (CMV, toxoplasmosis, syphilis, HSV, rubella)
- Sepsis
- UTI
- Hepatitis B / C

### 3. Metabolic
- Galactosemia
- Tyrosinemia type I
- α1-antitrypsin deficiency
- Hypothyroidism
- Niemann-Pick disease

### 4. PNALD (PN-associated liver disease)
- TPN > 14 d
- Sepsis episodes
- ELBW
- NEC / SBS history

### 5. Idiopathic neonatal hepatitis
- Diagnosis exclusion
- 30-40 % cases
- Better prognosis vs BA

## Initial workup (ESPGHAN/NASPGHAN 2017)

### Bloodwork
- **Direct bilirubin** + total bilirubin (confirm cholestasis)
- **AST, ALT, GGT** (biliary obstruction GGT > 2-3× normal)
- **Albumin, total protein**
- **Coag (PT, PTT, INR)** — synthetic function
- **CBC + reticulocytes** + DAT (hemolysis exclusion)
- **Glucose** (PFIC, fat oxidation defects)

### Targeted (по подозрению)
- **Galactose-1-phosphate** (galactosemia)
- **TSH, T4** (hypothyroidism)
- **α1-antitrypsin level + phenotype** (PiZZ deficient)
- **Sweat chloride** или CFTR genetics (CF)
- **TORCH titers + ПЦР**
- **Urinalysis + culture** (UTI)
- **Ammonia** (UCD if suspect)
- **Plasma + urine AA, organic acids** (IEM)

### Imaging
- **Abdominal ultrasound:** gallbladder presence, bile duct dilation, triangular cord sign (BA), cyst
- **HIDA scan** (biliary scintigraphy): excretion in 24 ч rule out BA. Phenobarbital pre-treatment 5 мг/кг/d × 5 d ↑ sensitivity.
- **MR cholangiopancreatography (MRCP):** non-invasive, rare у newborn (size limitations)
- **Liver biopsy:** definitive — гистология BA pattern (bile duct proliferation), giant cell hepatitis (idiopathic), specific PFIC features

## Treatment

### Surgical (when BA suspected)
- **Intraoperative cholangiogram** — confirms BA
- **Kasai portoenterostomy** by 60 d жизни — critical для outcome
  - 30-50 % achieve drainage permanent
  - 50-70 % eventually need liver transplant
- **Liver transplant** ultimate если Kasai fails

### Medical support
- **Ursodeoxycholic acid (UDCA)** 10-15 мг/кг q12h PO — choleretic, reduces cholestasis
- **Medium-chain triglyceride (MCT)** formula (Pregestimil, Alimentum) — better fat absorption когда bile flow impaired
- **Fat-soluble vitamins (ADEK)** — supplement при cholestasis
  - Vit A 5000-15000 ЕД q24h
  - Vit D 1000-2000 ЕД q24h (or calcitriol)
  - Vit E 25-50 ЕД/кг q24h (alpha-tocopherol form)
  - Vit K 1-5 мг q24h (water-soluble form preferred)
- **Cholestyramine** — sequester bile acids (rare у newborn)
- **Phenobarbital** — choleretic эффект (limited evidence)

### Long-term
- Nutritional optimization
- Pruritus management (rifampicin, naltrexone, ursodiol)
- Liver transplant evaluation если progressive

- neo-cholestasis-criteria (interactive)
- neo-bili-2022
- neo-tpn (PN cholestasis prevention)

## Источники

- Fawaz R et al. JPGN 2017;64:154 — NASPGHAN/ESPGHAN guidelines
- Sokol RJ et al. Hepatology 2007;46:566
- Mowat AP. Liver Disorders in Childhood 4th ed.
- КР МЗ РФ "Холестаз новорождённых" 2024

articles.summary: STABLE protocol pre-transport. Transport incubator pre-warmed. Monitoring continuous. Anticipate complications в transit.
articles.content:
## Pre-transport stabilization (STABLE protocol)

### S — Sugar/Safe care
- Glucose 2.5-7.0 ммоль/л (45-126 mg/dL)
- IV access secure (peripheral OR UVC)
- Glucose-containing IV fluid

### T — Temperature
- Normothermia 36.5-37.5 °C
- Pre-warmed transport incubator (≥ 26-28 °C ambient)
- Hat, polyethylene wrap для preterm
- Skin-to-skin until handover (if stable)

### A — Airway
- Adequate ventilation (SpO₂ pre-ductal target)
- ETT secured (if intubated) — re-confirm position
- Suction equipment ready

### B — Blood pressure
- MAP > 50 (term), age-appropriate (preterm)
- Inotropes на pre-prepared infusion lines
- Volume access secured

### L — Lab work
- ABG / VBG
- Glucose, electrolytes
- CBC, blood culture (if sepsis suspect)

### E — Emotional support
- Family communication
- Parent participation если возможно (one parent в transport)
- Photo / handprint pre-transport (if poor prognosis)

## Equipment checklist

### Transport incubator (servo-controlled)
- Pre-warmed к 36-37 °C
- Battery + AC power adapters
- Humidity capability

### Monitor
- ECG, SpO₂ pre + post-ductal, NIBP, T core
- ETCO₂ если intubated
- Backup batteries

### Ventilator
- Transport vent (Sechrist, Maquet, Babylog)
- Adequate O₂ supply (cylinder + reserve)
- Backup bag-mask + T-piece

### Medication kit
- Resuscitation drugs (adrenaline, atropine, NaCl)
- IV fluids (D10W, NS, LR)
- Inotropes pre-mixed (dopamine, epinephrine, norepi)
- Sedation / paralysis (fentanyl, vecuronium / rocuronium)
- Anticonvulsants (phenobarbital, levetiracetam)
- Emergency antibiotics (ампициллин, гентамицин, ceftriaxone)
- Surfactant (Curosurf / Survanta) если требуется

### Other
- Suction unit
- Endotracheal tubes (multiple sizes), laryngoscope
- IV catheters, tape, gauze
- Phototherapy lights (если bilirubin высокий)
- Stethoscope

## Transport modes

### Ground (ambulance)
- Most common (90 % transports)
- Distance < 200-300 km typically
- Speed: drive carefully, avoid abrupt acceleration / braking
- Vibration management (foam/gel pads)
- Window covers for thermal

### Helicopter
- For longer distance OR critical time-sensitive
- Pressurized cabin desirable (altitude effects O₂ saturation)
- Hearing protection для infant
- Vibration significant — secure all equipment

### Fixed-wing aircraft
- Long-distance transfers (> 300 km)
- Pressurized cabin (effective altitude < 8,000 ft)
- Anticipate cabin altitude — supplemental O₂ adjustments

## In-transit monitoring

- Vital signs documented q15-30 мин
- T core continuous
- SpO₂ pre + post-ductal
- BP q15 мин
- ETCO₂ если intubated
- Ventilator parameters (PIP, PEEP, rate, FiO₂)
- IV line patency
- Family contact updates

## Common complications в transit

- **Hypothermia** — most common (re-warm with skin-to-skin if possible, increase incubator T)
- **Hypoglycemia** — frequent glucose checks
- **Hypoxemia** — adjust FiO₂, optimize positioning, suction PRN
- **Hypotension** — fluid bolus, escalate inotropes
- **Apnea** — bag-ventilate, optimize support
- **Pneumothorax** — needle decompression bedside
- **Equipment failure** — backup ready, manual ventilation

- neo-thermal-management
- neo-resp-indices
- neo-resus-doses

- STABLE Program (Karlsen) — Sugar, Temperature, Airway, BP, Lab, Emotional support
- WHO Quality of Care for the Sick Newborn 2024

articles.summary: Palivizumab (Synagis) — passive monoclonal × 5 мес. Nirsevimab (Beyfortus) — single dose, longer-acting. AAP 2014 + 2023 updates.
articles.content:
## RSV — neonatal impact

- RSV (Respiratory Syncytial Virus) — leading cause acute LRTI у infants < 2 yr
- Hospitalization rate: 1-3 / 100 у preterm < 32 нед
- Mortality: 0.5-1 % hospitalized; up to 5 % в high-risk
- Long-term: ↑ asthma, recurrent wheezing

## Passive immunization

### Palivizumab (Synagis) — first-line through 2023

#### Mechanism
- Humanized monoclonal Ab against RSV F-protein
- Passive immunization (no infant immune response required)
- Given monthly (т ½ ~28 days)

#### Dose
- **15 мг/кг IM monthly** × 5 doses в RSV season
- Northern hemisphere: October-March/April

#### Indications (AAP 2014 — restricted high-risk only)
- **Preterm < 29 нед GA + < 1 yr** at start of season
- **Preterm 29-32 нед GA + < 6 мес** at start of season (US — discontinued 2014; РФ continues)
- **BPD/CLD** на supplemental O₂ ≥ 28 d жизни (within 1 yr)
- **Hemodynamically significant CHD**
- **Severe immunodeficiency**
- **Cystic fibrosis с lung disease** (selected)

#### Schedule
- 1st dose: October или November (Northern hemisphere)
- Subsequent: monthly through March-April
- Total 5 doses typically

### Nirsevimab (Beyfortus) — newer 2023

#### Mechanism
- Long-acting recombinant monoclonal Ab against RSV F-protein
- Half-life ~150 d (vs palivizumab 28 d)
- Single IM dose covers entire season

#### Dose
- **< 5 кг:** 50 мг IM
- **≥ 5 кг:** 100 мг IM

#### Indications (CDC ACIP 2023)
- ALL infants < 8 мес entering 1st RSV season (broad — not restricted к high-risk)
- 8-19 мес at high risk entering 2nd season (similar к palivizumab criteria)

#### Trials
- **MELODY trial** (Hammitt NEJM 2022): 75 % reduction medically attended LRTI vs placebo
- **HARMONIE trial** (Sanofi): 83 % reduction hospitalization in real-world

#### Real-world rollout
- US 2023-2024 season: shortage initial, CDC restricted к highest-risk
- Europe 2023-2024: broad implementation
- РФ: pending approval (2024-2025) — palivizumab пока остаётся standard

## Maternal RSVpreF vaccine

### Abrysvo (Pfizer) — approved 2023
- Maternal vaccination 32-36 нед gestation
- Transplacental antibody transfer → infant protection
- Reduces severe RSV LRTI 70 % (MATISSE trial NEJM 2023)
- Alternative или complementary to nirsevimab у infant

## Active vaccines (research)

### Adenoviral vectored, prefusion F
- Pre-clinical / phase trials
- НЕТ approved у infants currently
- Potential to eliminate need for monthly dosing

## Comparison palivizumab vs nirsevimab

| Параметр | Palivizumab | Nirsevimab |
|---|---|---|
| Dosing | Monthly × 5 | Single dose |
| Half-life | 28 d | ~150 d |
| Indications | High-risk only (АAP 2014) | All < 8 мес (CDC 2023) |
| Cost (US) | $1500-3000/dose × 5 = $7500-15000 | ~$500/dose |
| Trial efficacy | 50-55 % hospital reduction | 75-83 % |
| Approval region | Wide (РФ inclu) | US, EU, UK, Canada (РФ pending) |

## Side effects

### Both products
- Local injection site reactions (minor)
- Fever rare
- Anaphylaxis very rare (< 1 / 100,000)
- Generally well-tolerated

## Contraindications

- Severe hypersensitivity к prior dose
- Acute moderate-severe febrile illness (defer until resolved)
- НЕ contraindicated в immunocompromised (no live virus)

## Nonpharm RSV prevention

- Hand hygiene (caregivers, family)
- Avoid daycare exposure first 6 мес если высокий риск
- Avoid smoking exposure
- Limit visitors с cough/cold symptoms
- Breastfeeding (provides some protective antibodies)

- neo-prematurity-class
- neo-bpd-nih

- Hammitt LL et al. NEJM 2022;386:837 — MELODY (nirsevimab)
- Kampmann B et al. NEJM 2023;388:1451 — MATISSE (maternal Abrysvo)
- CDC ACIP 2023 — Nirsevimab recommendations
- КР МЗ РФ "Иммунопрофилактика РСВ" 2023

## Vitamin K

### Profilaktika всем
- **1 мг IM** при рождении (в первые 6 ч)
- Preterm < 1500 г: 0.5 мг IM
- Без profilaktiki — VKDB risk

### PO alternative (если IM refused)
- 2 мг PO at birth + 2 мг при 1 нед + 2 мг при 4 нед
- Не как effective как IM (особенно для late VKDB)

## Vitamin D

### Suprovision
- **400-1000 МЕ/день PO** для всех breast-fed infants и mixed-fed
- Formula-fed: 1000 мл formula provides ~400 IU; supplementation если < 1000 мл/day
- VLBW < 1500 g: 800-1000 IU/d (higher need)

### Maternal high-dose alternative
- Hollis 2015: 6400 IU/d у lactating mother — устраняет need infant supplementation
- Нет в обычной practice (compliance + cost)

## Iron

### Profilaktika
- **Term breast-fed:** 1 мг/кг/d PO от 4 мес
- **Term formula-fed:** Fe-fortified formula (most have ~12 мг/л Fe)
- **Preterm < 37 нед:** 2 мг/кг/d PO от 2-4 нед жизни (after stable enteral feeds)
- **VLBW + EPO:** 4-6 мг/кг/d (higher need)
- Continue до 1 yr возраста

### Treatment iron-deficiency anemia
- 3-6 мг/кг/d split q12h × 8-12 нед
- Recheck Hb/ferritin при completion

## Folic acid

### Term newborn
- Не routinely supplemented
- Adequate в breastmilk + formula

### Preterm < 32 нед
- 0.5-1 мг q24h PO от 2 нед жизни до 2-3 мес
- ↓ Megaloblastic anemia

## Vitamin E

### Preterm
- 5-25 ЕД/d PO (after enteral feeds)
- ↓ Anemia hemolytic у ELBW
- В TPN: 2.8 ЕД/кг/d

### Caveats
- High doses > 50 ЕД/d у preterm — ↑ NEC risk (controversial)
- РF: рoutine supplementation more conservative

## Vitamin A

### Preterm < 1000 g
- IM 5000 ЕД 3×/нед × 28 дней (Tyson 1999 — ↓ BPD)
- Controversial: small benefit, painful injections

### General
- Term: не routine
- Multivitamin (MVI Pediatric): 0.7-1.5 мг/d daily в TPN

## Zinc

### Preterm + chronic loss (NEC, SBS)
- 0.5-1 мг/кг/d PO при low levels
- Stoma output replacement formula contains Zn
- TPN: 250-450 мкг/кг/d

## Selenium

### Preterm на TPN > 1 month
- 2 мкг/кг/d IV
- Otherwise rarely supplemented

## Copper

### TPN
- 20 мкг/кг/d IV
- НЕТ в TPN у cholestasis (toxicity)

## Calcium + Phosphate

See art-tpn для PN doses.

Enteral:
- Term breast: 200-400 мг Ca + 100-200 мг P /day estimated
- Preterm formula fortified (HMF): 300-400 мг Ca + 200-300 мг P в день

## Multivitamin (PN)

MVI Pediatric (Infuvite Pediatric) — 5 мл/d daily в TPN
- Vit A, D, E, K, B1, B2, B3, B5, B6, B12, C, biotin, folate

articles.summary: SCID screen RUSP. T-cell receptor excision circles (TRECs). Treatment: HSCT before 3.5 мес.
articles.content:
## Развитие неонатального иммунитета

### Innate
- Phagocytes (neutrophils, macrophages) — present, но reduced function
- NK cells — present
- Complement — reduced classical pathway
- TLR signaling — variable

### Adaptive
- T cells (thymus развивается с 6-8 нед gestation)
- B cells (production IgM от рождения; IgG transferred от matери transplacentally от 17 нед)
- IgM, IgA — низкие у newborn (own production starts)
- IgG — same as maternal at birth, declines к 3-6 мес ("physiological hypogammaglobulinemia")

### Maternal antibody transfer
- IgG transplacental: peak transfer 3rd trimester
- IgA через breast milk: protects gut
- Преtermin born < 32 нед: less IgG transfer → ↑ infection risk

## Newborn Screening для SCID

### TRECs (T-cell receptor excision circles)
- Marker recent thymic T-cell production
- Low TRECs → SCID или другие T-cell defects
- Включён в US RUSP since 2010
- РФ: pending включение в Расширенный screening

### Workup low TRECs
- Lymphocyte subsets (CD3, CD4, CD8, CD19, CD56)
- T-cell function (PHA proliferation)
- Genetic panel (IL2RG, JAK3, ADA, RAG1, RAG2, CD3D, CD3E, CORO1A, и др.)
- Flow cytometry naive vs memory T cells

## SCID — обзор

### Forms
- **X-linked (IL2RG)** — most common, 50 %
- **JAK3 deficiency** — autosomal recessive
- **ADA (adenosine deaminase)** — autosomal recessive, 15 %
- **RAG1/RAG2** — failure V(D)J recombination
- **Reticular dysgenesis** — most severe, AK2 mutation

### Presentation
- Recurrent severe infections от 3 мес
- FTT (failure to thrive)
- Persistent diarrhea
- Pneumonia (especially Pneumocystis jirovecii)
- Mucocutaneous candidiasis
- BCG-osis (после BCG vaccination, fatal в SCID)

### Workup
- TRECs low/absent
- ALC (absolute lymphocyte count) < 2000 /µл (term) или < 3000 (preterm)
- T-cell percentage / count low
- HIV PCR (exclude)
- Maternal-fetal-T-cell engraftment (graft-vs-host)

### Treatment
- **Reverse-isolation** до transplant
- **HSCT (hematopoietic stem cell transplant)** — definitive — best outcome before 3.5 мес возраста (90 % survival)
- **PEG-ADA** для ADA-SCID (enzyme replacement)
- **Gene therapy** — emerging для X-SCID, ADA, others
- **IVIG** monthly до restoration immunity
- **Pneumocystis prophylaxis** (TMP-SMX 5 мг/кг/d)
- **Avoid live vaccines** (BCG, MMR, rotavirus, varicella)
- **CMV-negative blood products** + irradiated

## Other primary immunodeficiencies

### DiGeorge (22q11.2 deletion)
- Cardiac (TOF, IAA, truncus)
- Hypoparathyroidism (hypocalcemia)
- Thymic hypoplasia → T-cell deficiency variable
- Facial features
- Treatment: thymic transplant (severe forms), Ca/PTH replacement, support

### Wiskott-Aldrich syndrome
- X-linked
- Triad: thrombocytopenia, eczema, immunodeficiency
- HSCT curative

### Common Variable Immunodeficiency (CVID)
- Late onset (childhood-adulthood usually)
- Recurrent sinopulmonary infections
- IVIG replacement

### Hyper-IgM syndromes
- CD40L deficiency (X-linked)
- High IgM, low IgG/IgA
- ↑ Pneumocystis, Cryptosporidium

## CMV-negative blood products у preterm

- VLBW < 1500 g + symptomatic CMV cause cCMV-like syndrome
- Use CMV-seronegative donor blood
- Irradiation (15 Gy) prevents transfusion-associated GVHD
- Leukocyte-reduction (filtration) — even safer

## Vaccines у preterm + immunocompromised

### Inactivated — give по schedule
- HBV, DTaP, IPV, Hib, PCV13, IIV (flu)
- Same chronological age как term

### Live — defer/avoid если SCID/severe immunodeficiency
- BCG (РФ при ≥ 2000 g, term)
- Rotavirus (start ≤ 14 нед 6 d)
- MMR + Varicella (12-15 мес чronological)
- Yellow fever — avoid если возможно

- neo-vaccination-calendar
- neo-ivig-dose

- Notarangelo LD. NEJM 2010;363:1283 — SCID review

## BPD-PH (BPD-associated pulmonary hypertension) — клиническая значимость

- 25-30 % severe BPD
- Mortality в BPD-PH: 30-40 % (vs 5-10 % в BPD без PH)
- Long-term: persistent PH в childhood-adolescence

## Patofiziologia

- Disrupted pulmonary vascular development у extreme preterm
- ↓ Vessel density
- Persistent pulmonary vasoconstriction
- Hypertrophy media + intima
- Variable response к O₂

## Risk факторы

- ELBW < 1000 g
- Severe BPD
- IUGR / SGA
- Chronic intermittent hypoxemia (BPD-related)
- Recurrent infections (RSV, cytomegalovirus)
- Aspiration (GERD)
- Maternal preeclampsia

## Скрининг

### Кого
- Severe BPD на supplemental O₂ at 36 нед PMA
- Persistent O₂ requirement без weaning
- Failure to thrive
- Cyanotic episodes / desaturation

### Когда
- ECHO at 36 нед PMA для всех severe BPD
- Repeat если progression / new symptoms

### ECHO маркеры
- Right ventricular hypertrophy (RVH)
- TAPSE < 5th percentile age-adjusted
- TR jet velocity > 2.7 м/с
- Septal flattening (D-shaped LV)
- PA acceleration time < 90 ms
- Estimated PA pressure > 35 mmHg или > 2/3 systemic

### Cardiac catheterization (definitive)
- Резерв for severe или unclear cases
- Confirms PH, measures PA pressure directly
- Tests vasoreactivity

## Лечение

### Optimization first
- **Aggressive O₂** — keep SpO₂ ≥ 92-95 % (avoid intermittent hypoxemia)
- **Diuretics** для chronic edema (furosemide, spironolactone, chlorothiazide)
- **Nutrition optimization** (catch-up growth)
- **GERD treatment** (PPI если symptomatic)
- **Tracheostomy** для long-term MV если severe
- **RSV prophylaxis** (palivizumab / nirsevimab)

### PDE5 inhibitors
- **Sildenafil** 0.5-2 мг/кг q6h PO (start 0.5, titrate)
- IV form: 0.4-1 мг/кг q6h
- Long-term — usually months-years
- Monitor systemic BP (vasodilation effect)

### Endothelin receptor antagonists
- **Bosentan** 1-2 мг/кг q12h PO
- Liver function monitoring (LFT q month)
- Used в severe BPD-PH (less data у newborn)

### Prostacyclin analogs (severe)
- **Treprostinil** SC continuous (older infants/children)
- Reserved для severe / refractory

### Inhaled NO (chronic)
- Continuous home iNO у some severe BPD-PH cases
- Bridge к oral therapy или transplant
- Costly — limited center availability

### Avoid
- Hypoxia (SpO₂ < 90 %)
- Acidosis
- Hypothermia
- Hyperthermia
- Stress / pain (worsens PVR)
- Infections — vigilant prevention

## Outcomes

### Resolution
- 50-60 % survive первый year — PH may resolve gradually over 1-3 yr
- Some require long-term medication
- ~10 % progress к persistent severe PH adolescent

### Mortality
- BPD-PH severe: 30-40 % к first year
- BPD без PH: 5-10 %

articles.title_ru: Cyanotic spell у TOF — emergency management
articles.summary: Knee-chest position + 100% O2 + морфин 0.1 мг/кг + propranolol 0.05-0.1 мг/кг IV slow. Phenylephrine if refractory.
articles.content:
## Patofiziologia tet spell

Tetralogy of Fallot (TOF) — cyanotic CHD с:
1. Pulmonary stenosis (RV outflow obstruction)
2. VSD (interventricular communication)
3. Right ventricular hypertrophy
4. Aortic override

**Tet spell mechanism:**
- Triggers (crying, dehydration, fever, defecation, hypoxia) →
- ↓ SVR → ↓ pressure gradient между aorta и RV →
- ↑ R-to-L shunt через VSD →
- ↓ PBF (pulmonary blood flow) →
- ↓ SpO₂ (cyanosis worsens) →
- Acidosis → further ↓ SVR (vicious cycle)

## Триггеры

- Crying, agitation
- Defecation (Valsalva)
- Dehydration
- Fever / hyperthermia
- Anesthesia induction
- Procedures (IV start, blood draw)
- Morning awakening (typical у некоторых infants)
- Hot bath
- Prolonged crying after vaccines

## Клиника

- Sudden cyanosis worsening (lips, fingertips → trunk)
- Hyperpnea (not necessarily distress — "air hunger")
- Irritability / inconsolable crying
- Inevitable progression к loss of consciousness if untreated
- Severe: limpness, seizure-like, syncope, eventual hypoxic-ischemic injury OR death

## Management — algorithm

### Step 1: Position (immediate)
- **Knee-chest position** — flex hips fully (mom holds infant, knees к chest)
  - Mechanism: ↑ SVR by abdominal compression
  - ↑ Venous return
  - Most effective non-pharm intervention
- Older child: **squat** (similar effect)

### Step 2: Calm + O₂
- **100 % O₂** via mask или NC
  - Mechanism: pulmonary vasodilation, ↑ SaO₂ in mixing physiology
- **Calm environment** — dim lights, soft talking, parent holding
- **Avoid** painful stimuli (no IV start unless absolutely needed)

### Step 3: Morphine — first-line pharm
- **0.1-0.2 мг/кг IM** (preferred initially — no IV access stress)
- **0.05-0.1 мг/кг IV slow** (if access available)
- Mechanism: blunts sympathetic drive + reduces hyperpnea
- Decreases catecholamine surge
- Sedation — calm child

### Step 4: Volume bolus
- **NaCl 0.9 % 10 мл/кг IV** over 10-20 мин
- Increases preload, helps maintain SVR

### Step 5: Propranolol — second-line
- **0.05-0.1 мг/кг IV slow over 5-10 мин** (max 0.15 мг/кг)
- Mechanism: β-blockade reduces RV outflow tract (RVOT) infundibular spasm + ↓ HR
- Caution: hypotension, bradycardia
- Continuous ECG monitoring
- Repeat доза possible после 10-15 мин

### Step 6: Phenylephrine (refractory)
- **5-20 мкг/кг IV** bolus (slow)
- Mechanism: pure α1 agonist → ↑ SVR → ↓ R-to-L shunt
- Onset rapid; duration 5-10 мин
- Continuous BP monitoring

### Step 7: Bicarbonate (acidosis correction)
- **NaHCO₃ 1-2 ммоль/кг IV** if pH < 7.20
- Correct severe acidosis (vasoconstriction reversal)

### Step 8: General anesthesia + intubation (severe persistent)
- Если spell не resolves 
- Sedation: ketamine (preferred — maintains SVR), midazolam
- Avoid drugs lowering SVR (propofol — caution)

### Step 9: Emergency surgery
- Refractory к all above
- Requires immediate cardiac surgery (BT shunt placement или urgent complete repair)

## После spell — long-term

### Prevention
- **Propranolol** 1-4 мг/кг/d split q6-8h PO chronic — reduces frequency
- Adequate hydration
- Avoid known triggers
- Treat fever promptly
- Anti-anxiety / pain management для procedures

### Surgical timing
- Tet spell — indication для earlier surgical repair
- Complete repair typically 4-6 мес возраста (after spells start, may be earlier)
- Palliative BT shunt если too small / unstable для complete repair

- AAP / AHA — CHD management 2024
- AHA 2019 PPHN Scientific Statement

articles.summary: Birth: cord clamp + lung expansion = SVR↑, PVR↓. Closure DA, FO, DV. PPHN — failed transition.
articles.content:
## Fetal circulation (review)

- Placenta — gas exchange + nutrition
- High PVR, low SVR
- 3 shunts:
  1. **Ductus venosus** — IVC ← umbilical vein (bypasses liver)
  2. **Foramen ovale** — RA ← LA (oxygenated blood к brain)
  3. **Ductus arteriosus** — PA → aorta (bypasses lungs)
- Oxygen saturation gradient: brain > rest of body

## Transition at birth — stepwise

### Lung expansion (минут)
- First breaths → lung inflation → ↓ pulmonary vascular resistance (PVR)
- ↓ PVR by 80 % first hour
- Pulmonary blood flow ↑ 8-10× baseline

### Cord clamping
- Delayed cord clamping ≥ 60 sec preferred
- Removes placental low-resistance circuit
- ↑ SVR (systemic vascular resistance)
- ↑ Aortic + LV pressure

### Foramen ovale closure
- ↑ LA pressure relative к RA → flap closes (functional within hours)
- Anatomic closure 3 мес — 1 yr (PFO persists в ~25 % adults)

### Ductus arteriosus closure
- ↑ PaO₂ + ↓ prostaglandins (from placenta) → DA constricts
- Functional closure: 24-72 ч term newborn
- Anatomic closure: 2-3 нед
- Preterm: more sensitive к prostaglandins, slower closure (30-40 % patent at 7 d)

### Ductus venosus closure
- ↓ Umbilical vein pressure → smooth muscle constricts
- Functional closure: 3-7 d
- Anatomic: 14-21 d

## Failure of transition

### PPHN (Persistent Pulmonary Hypertension of Newborn)
- Failure PVR drop
- Right-to-left shunting через PDA + PFO
- Causes: maladaptation (sepsis, asphyxia), maldevelopment (CDH), surfactant deficiency, MAS
- Treatment: iNO, sildenafil, milrinone, ECMO

### PDA HSPDA
- Failure DA closure (especially preterm)
- Left-to-right shunt → pulmonary overcirculation
- Treatment: ibuprofen / paracetamol / indomethacin / surgical ligation

### Patent foramen ovale
- Persistence in 25 % adults — usually benign
- Rare clinical significance neonate

## Pre/post-ductal SpO₂

### Setup
- **Pre-ductal:** right hand SpO₂ probe (right subclavian artery — pre-PDA)
- **Post-ductal:** foot SpO₂ probe (descending aorta — post-PDA)

### Interpretation
- **Equal:** No PDA shunt
- **Pre > Post by ≥ 5-10 %:** R-to-L shunt через PDA → PPHN или ductal-dependent CHD
- **Pre < Post:** Reverse differential — TGA + restrictive PFO
- **Both equally low (< 90 %):** parallel circulation (TGA, HLHS)

## CCHD pulse oximetry screening

- Routine 24-48 h жизни (term + late preterm ≥ 35 нед)
- Right hand + either foot
- Pass: ≥ 95 % both sides AND difference < 3 %
- Fail: < 90 % OR persistent < 95 % после 3 measurements + 1 ч; OR ≥ 3 % difference
- Fail → ECHO obligatory

- Heated electrode (43-44 °C) расширяет capillaries → arterialization
- Diffusion CO₂ + O₂ через skin
- Reads close к arterial values

- Continuous monitoring trends — не replace ABG
- Useful у severe RDS, MAS, CDH, BPD

- q4h (recommended)

- q4h — burns risk при longer
- Avoid bony prominences
- Avoid edema, infected skin
- Skin assessment q hour

- Slow response time (90 sec lag)
- Less accurate у hypoperfusion
- Skin probe burns 1-3 % если no rotation
- Not reliable при vasoconstriction

## aEEG (Amplitude-integrated EEG)

### Применение
- HIE prognostication
- Seizure detection
- TH monitoring
- Sedation depth assessment

### Background patterns
| Pattern | Description | Prognosis |
|---|---|---|
| **Continuous normal voltage (CNV)** | Upper > 10 µV, lower > 5 µV | Normal |
| **Discontinuous normal voltage (DNV)** | Variable | Mild HIE — good outcome |
| **Burst-suppression** | Bursts of high voltage + flat periods | Severe HIE — poor outcome |
| **Continuous low voltage (CLV)** | < 5 µV continuous | Severe HIE |
| **Flat trace (FT)** | < 5 µV always | Very poor |

### Sleep-wake cycling
- Apparent после ~24 ч жизни в healthy
- Absence в HIE — severity marker

### Seizure detection
- aEEG sensitivity 30-50 % vs full EEG
- Combine с full montage EEG для definitive
- Visible на trace as sudden voltage rise

### Limitations
- Low spatial resolution (2 channels typical)
- Misses focal seizures often
- Not replacement для full EEG

articles.content:
## Categories

### 1. Arterial ischemic stroke (AIS)
- Most common — MCA distribution (left > right)
- Risk factors: maternal preeclampsia, twin gestation, infection, polycythemia, congenital cardiac

### 2. Cerebral sinovenous thrombosis (CSVT)
- 1/40000 livebirths
- Superior sagittal sinus most common
- Risk: dehydration, infection, polycythemia, prothrombotic

### 3. Hemorrhagic stroke
- IVH grade IV (PVHI)
- Subarachnoid (SAH)
- Subdural (rare у newborn)

## Presentation

### Acute
- Focal seizures (most common — first 72 h)
- Hemiparesis (often subtle у newborn)
- Apnea
- Lethargy
- Feeding difficulty

### Subacute / chronic
- Asymmetric Moro
- Persistent fisting one hand
- Delayed milestones
- Seizure recurrence

## Diagnostics

### Imaging
- **MRI brain DWI** — gold standard (diffusion restriction immediate)
- **MRA** — vessel patency
- **MRV** — venous sinuses (CSVT exclusion)
- **Cranial US** — limited sensitivity для AIS у newborn
- **CT** — if MRI unavailable (radiation concerns у newborn)

### Workup
- Coagulation panel + thrombophilia screen
- Echo (cardiac source — PFO, CHD)
- Doppler carotid + cerebral vessels
- ECG
- Genetic counseling

## Treatment

### Acute
- **Supportive** — maintain perfusion, avoid hypotension/hypoxia
- **Anticonvulsants** при seizures (phenobarbital / levetiracetam)
- **NO routine thrombolysis** у newborn (limited evidence, risk bleeding)
- **Anticoagulation** у CSVT — controversial; некоторые centers heparin/LMWH; AHA Pediatric Stroke 2019 conditional
- **Avoid hyperthermia** (worsens injury)

### Long-term
- Early intervention (PT/OT)
- AED prophylaxis controversial — usually only при confirmed seizures
- Hemiplegia management
- Speech / language therapy
- High-risk follow-up clinic

## Outcomes

- **Hemiparesis** ~50 % survivors AIS
- **Cognitive delays** 40-60 %
- **Epilepsy** 30 %
- **Speech / language delays** 30-40 %
- **Mortality** 5-10 %

articles.content:
## Categories

### 1. Catheter-related (most common)
- UVC, UAC, PICC, CVC
- Femoral, subclavian, IJ veins
- 1-3 % с indwelling catheters
- Often asymptomatic (detected on echo / Doppler)

### 2. Renal vein thrombosis
- ELBW, polycythemia, dehydration, IDM
- Presentation: hematuria, palpable abdominal mass, thrombocytopenia
- US: enlarged echogenic kidney, absent venous flow

### 3. Arterial thromboembolism
- Aortic (UAC-related)
- Peripheral (rare)
- Iliac / femoral (catheter complication)

### 4. Cerebral sinovenous thrombosis
- See art-stroke

## Risk factors

### Maternal
- Diabetes (IDM)
- Preeclampsia
- Antiphospholipid syndrome
- Maternal infection / sepsis

### Neonatal
- Indwelling catheters
- Sepsis
- Polycythemia (HCT > 65)
- Dehydration
- Prothrombotic disorders (Factor V Leiden, prothrombin G20210A)
- Congenital cardiac (especially Fontan, BT shunt)

## Diagnostics

- **Doppler ultrasound** — first-line vessels
- **Echo** — intracardiac, IVC tip
- **Venogram** — gold standard (rare у newborn — radiation)
- **MRV** — cerebral, renal
- **Coagulation panel + thrombophilia screen** (selected cases)

## Treatment (decisions individualized)

### Conservative (asymptomatic catheter-related)
- Remove catheter ASAP
- Monitor с serial Doppler
- Most resolve spontaneously

### Anticoagulation (symptomatic, occlusive, large)
- **Heparin** continuous IV: 28 ед/кг/h, titrate aPTT 60-85 sec
- **LMWH (enoxaparin)** 1-1.5 мг/кг q12h SC, titrate anti-Xa 0.5-1.0
- Duration: 6 weeks — 3 months typically

### Thrombolysis (life/limb-threatening)
- **Alteplase** 0.1-0.5 мг/кг/h IV × 6 ч (limb / organ ischemia)
- High bleeding risk у newborn — last-resort, ICU + IR
- Catheter clearance: alteplase 0.5-2 мг intra-luminal

### Avoid
- Aspirin у newborn (Reye syndrome)
- Routine anticoagulation у asymptomatic small thrombi

articles.content:
## Definition

CHI — most common cause persistent neonatal hypoglycemia. Inappropriate insulin secretion при low glucose.

## Genetics

### Channels (most common — 40-60 %)
- **ABCC8** (SUR1 subunit KATP channel) — autosomal recessive (focal или diffuse)
- **KCNJ11** (Kir6.2 subunit KATP) — same
- Diazoxide-unresponsive typically

### Metabolic
- **GLUD1** (glutamate dehydrogenase) — hyperinsulinism + hyperammonemia syndrome
- **GCK** (glucokinase) — autosomal dominant
- **HADH** (3-hydroxyacyl-CoA dehydrogenase)
- **HNF4A, HNF1A** (transient or permanent)
- **SLC16A1** (exercise-induced)

### Syndromic
- **Beckwith-Wiedemann syndrome** — 50 % с hypoglycemia
- **Sotos syndrome**
- **Kabuki syndrome**

## Diagnostic criteria

### Critical sample (during hypoglycemia < 2.5 ммоль/л)
- **Insulin** > 2 µE/мл (inappropriately high)
- **C-peptide** > 0.5 ng/мл
- **β-hydroxybutyrate** < 1.5 ммоль/л (suppressed)
- **Free fatty acids** < 1 ммоль/л (suppressed)
- Growth hormone normal
- Cortisol > 18 µg/дл (450 нмоль/л)
- Ammonia (high in GLUD1)

### Glucagon stimulation test
- 0.03 мг/кг IM/IV during hypoglycemia
- Glucose ↑ > 1.6 ммоль/л в 30 мин = positive (CHI characteristic)
- IEM other → no response

## Treatment hierarchy

### 1. Glucose support
- D10W bolus 2 мл/кг IV slow (200 мг/кг)
- Continuous GIR — start 8-10 мг/кг/мин, titrate up до 25-30 if needed
- Goal glucose > 3.5 ммоль/л

### 2. Diazoxide — first-line CHI
- 5-15 мг/кг/d split q8h PO
- Mechanism: opens KATP channels (only effective if channel functional — i.e., not ABCC8/KCNJ11 mutations)
- Trial 5 days; if responsive, continue chronic
- Side effects: hirsutism, fluid retention, pulmonary HTN (rare)

### 3. Octreotide (diazoxide-unresponsive)
- 5-25 мкг/кг/d split q6-8h SC or continuous IV
- Long-acting somatostatin analog — inhibits insulin release
- Side effects: NEC concerns (avoid с other risk factors), gallstones long-term

### 4. Other (refractory)
- Continuous glucose monitoring (CGM)
- Sirolimus (rare — diffuse CHI selected)
- Glucagon infusion (short-term bridge)

### 5. Surgical
- **Genetic testing first** (ABCC8/KCNJ11 mutations)
- **18F-DOPA PET imaging** — distinguishes focal (single lesion) vs diffuse
- **Focal CHI:** 95-98 % pancreatectomy curative
- **Diffuse CHI:** subtotal pancreatectomy (98 %) — high diabetes risk later

- neo-diazoxide-dose, neo-octreotide-dose, neo-glucagon-dose

articles.content:
## Definition + epidemiology

CAH — autosomal recessive group disorders adrenal steroid synthesis.

- **21-hydroxylase deficiency (CYP21A2)** — 95 % всех cases
- **11β-hydroxylase deficiency** — 5 %
- **3β-HSD, 17α-hydroxylase** — < 1 % each

**Incidence:** 1 / 14000-18000 (classic 21-OHD).

## Pathophysiology 21-OHD

- ↓ Cortisol synthesis → ACTH ↑ feedback → adrenal hyperplasia
- ↓ Aldosterone (salt-wasting form)
- ↑ 17-OH-progesterone (substrate accumulation)
- ↑ Androgens (shunted)

## Classifications

### Classic salt-wasting (75 %)
- Severe CYP21A2 mutation
- Cortisol + aldosterone deficiency
- Salt-wasting crisis 1-3 нед жизни
- Genital virilization (ambiguous genitalia girls; precocious в boys)

### Classic simple-virilizing (25 %)
- Partial enzyme activity
- Cortisol low; aldosterone preserved
- Virilization без salt-wasting

### Non-classic (late-onset)
- Mild deficiency
- Onset childhood / adolescence
- НЕ neonatal usually

## Newborn screening

- Расширенный screen в РФ + RUSP includes 17-OH-progesterone
- Sensitivity ~85 % (false negatives if antenatal steroids given)
- Confirmation: serum 17-OHP, electrolytes, ACTH stim test, genetics

## Salt-wasting crisis presentation

- Onset 1-3 нед жизни
- **Vomiting**, lethargy, poor feeding
- **Dehydration**
- **Hyponatremia** (Na < 130)
- **Hyperkalemia** (K > 6)
- **Hypoglycemia** (rare)
- **Metabolic acidosis**
- Shock в severe untreated

## Workup

- **Electrolytes, glucose, ABG**
- **17-OH-progesterone** (highly elevated в classic 21-OHD)
- **ACTH stim test** (cortisol response)
- **Plasma renin activity** + aldosterone
- **Karyotype + DSD evaluation** в ambiguous genitalia
- **Genetic CYP21A2 mutations**
- **Pelvic US** (Müllerian structures girls)

## Treatment

### Acute crisis
- **Hydrocortisone** stress dose 25 мг IV bolus, then 25-50 мг/m²/d split q6h
- **NaCl 0.9 % bolus** 10-20 мл/кг IV если shock
- **Glucose** D10W если hypoglycemic
- **Hyperkalemia**: insulin/glucose, calcium gluconate, kayexalate
- **AVOID dexamethasone** (no mineralocorticoid activity)

### Maintenance
- **Hydrocortisone** 8-15 мг/m²/d split q8-12h PO
- **Fludrocortisone (Florinef)** 0.05-0.2 мг/d PO для salt-wasting
- **NaCl supplementation** 1-3 g/d (или 17-34 ммоль/d) infants первый year
- **Stress doses** (3× базовая) при febrile illness, surgery, trauma

### Surgical (girls с ambiguous genitalia)
- Genitoplasty obtained child-friendly age (currently 6-24 мес controversial; некоторые advocate later)

## Long-term

- Lifelong replacement therapy
- Endocrinology follow-up
- Adolescent growth + puberty management
- Adrenal crisis prevention (medical alert bracelet)
- Fertility considerations

- neo-newborn-screening (17-OHP timing)

- Speiser PW et al. J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2018;103:4043

- РФ Приказ МЗ 2023 (включает 17-OHP в expanded screen)

articles.content:
## Definition

22q11.2 deletion syndrome (also called DiGeorge / VCFS / Shprintzen) — most common deletion syndrome (1/4000-6000 births). Variable phenotype.

## CATCH-22 mnemonic

- **C**ardiac defects (75 %)
- **A**bnormal facies
- **T**hymic hypoplasia (T-cell deficiency)
- **C**left palate
- **H**ypocalcemia (60-80 %)
- **22q11.2** deletion

## Cardiac defects (most common)

- **Tetralogy of Fallot** (20 %)
- **Interrupted aortic arch** type B (50 % of IAA cases)
- **Truncus arteriosus** (35 % of truncus cases)
- **VSD** (15 %)
- **Right aortic arch**
- **Vascular ring**

## Hypocalcemia

### Mechanism
- Parathyroid hypoplasia / aplasia → ↓ PTH
- Ca < 1.75 ммоль/л common

### Treatment
- **Calcium gluconate 10 % 0.5-1 мл/кг IV slow** acute
- Continuous infusion 50-200 мг/кг/d Ca gluconate в TPN
- **Calcitriol** 0.025-0.1 мкг/кг/d PO (active vit D)
- **Phosphorus restriction** (low-P formula если severe)
- Lifelong replacement если permanent hypoparathyroidism

## Immunological

### Severity spectrum
- **Complete DiGeorge** (< 1 %) — absent thymus + T cells; phenotype like SCID
- **Partial DiGeorge** (>99 %) — variable T-cell numbers, mostly mild

### T-cell function
- TRECs may be low (newborn screen)
- Detailed immunology: CD3/4/8 counts, T-cell function (PHA proliferation)

### Treatment severe T-cell deficiency
- **Reverse-isolation** до immune reconstitution
- **CMV-negative + irradiated blood products**
- **Avoid live vaccines** (BCG, MMR, rotavirus)
- **IVIG monthly** если humoral defect
- **Pneumocystis prophylaxis** TMP-SMX 5 мг/кг/d
- **Thymic transplant** — для complete DiGeorge specialist centers (Markert protocol Duke)
- **HSCT** alternative для complete DiGeorge

## Other features

### Facial
- Long face
- Hooded eyelids
- Bulbous nasal tip
- Small mouth
- Mild ear abnormalities

### Cleft palate
- Submucous cleft common (overt < 10 %)
- Velopharyngeal incompetence (speech)
- Nasal regurgitation feeding

### Renal
- Anomalies (40-50 %)
- Renal agenesis, dysgenesis, multicystic

### Other
- Skeletal anomalies
- Learning disabilities (variable)
- Psychiatric (schizophrenia ↑ risk adult)
- Thrombocytopenia (rare)

## Diagnostics

### Confirmation
- **FISH 22q11.2** (TUPLE1, N25 probes)
- **Microarray (CMA)** — preferred, finds smaller deletions too
- **MLPA** — alternative

### Workup at diagnosis
- **Echocardiogram** (cardiac defects)
- **Calcium + PTH** (hypoparathyroidism)
- **CBC + lymphocyte subsets** (T-cell deficiency)
- **Renal US** (CAKUT)
- **Cleft palate evaluation** (ENT)
- **Genetic counseling** (familial recurrence risk)

articles.summary: Vertebral, Anal, Cardiac, Tracheoesophageal, Renal, Limb anomalies. ≥ 3 defects = VACTERL. Surgical correction sequenced.
articles.content:
## VACTERL acronym

- **V**ertebral anomalies (60-80 %): hemivertebrae, butterfly vertebrae, scoliosis
- **A**nal atresia / imperforate anus (55-90 %)
- **C**ardiac defects (40-80 %): VSD, ASD, TOF, PDA
- **T**racheoesophageal fistula / esophageal atresia (50-80 %)
- **R**enal anomalies (50-80 %): agenesis, dysplasia, vesicoureteral reflux
- **L**imb defects (40-50 %): radial dysplasia, polydactyly

### Diagnosis
- ≥ 3 component defects
- Exclude single-gene syndromes (Fanconi, CHARGE)

## Workup at diagnosis

### Imaging / studies
- **CXR** + abdominal X-ray (bowel gas, vertebrae)
- **Echocardiogram** (cardiac)
- **Renal US** (anomalies)
- **Spine US** или MRI (tethered cord exclusion)
- **Esophagogram** или endoscopy (TEF/EA suspicion)
- **Abdominal US** (anorectal malformation)
- **Limb radiographs** (radial defect)

### Genetics
- **Karyotype + microarray (CMA)**
- **Fanconi anemia testing** (chromosomal breakage study) — important rule-out
- VACTERL is sporadic — no specific gene yet identified

## Component management

### Esophageal atresia / TEF
- **Type C** (proximal pouch + distal TEF) — 85 % cases
- **Surgical repair** typical first 24-72 h life
- **NG-tube / Replogle** suction proximal pouch (prevent aspiration)
- **NPO** + IV fluids until repair
- **Anastomotic leak** 10-20 %
- **Gap > 2 cm** — staged repair (cervical esophagostomy + gastric pull-up later)

### Imperforate anus
- **Low** (subcutaneous fistula) — perineal anoplasty
- **High** (cloacal type) — colostomy first → posterior sagittal anorectoplasty (PSARP) 6-12 мес → colostomy closure later
- **Long-term**: continence issues, constipation

### Cardiac
- See art-cardiac-surgery (general approach)
- Surgery sequence based on cardiac severity vs other defects

### Vertebral / spinal
- Tethered cord 5-15 % — surgery if symptomatic
- Scoliosis development monitored

### Renal
- Hydronephrosis treatment
- VUR — antibiotic prophylaxis or surgical reflux correction
- Solitary kidney — long-term nephrology follow-up

### Limb
- Radial dysplasia — orthopedics/hand surgery (centralization, pollicization)

## Coordinated approach

VACTERL infants need MULTIDISCIPLINARY team:
- Neonatology
- Cardiac surgery / cardiology
- Pediatric surgery (TEF + anus + abdomen)
- Orthopedics (limb + spine)
- Urology (renal)
- Genetics + counseling
- Speech therapy (later — voice / swallow post-TEF)
- Long-term follow-up clinic

## Outcomes

- Mortality 25-30 % first year (severe cardiac + multi-system)
- Survivors often achieve good function-level long-term
- Continence + cardiac + spine — main long-term challenges

articles.summary: Triad: micrognathia + glossoptosis + cleft palate. Airway obstruction — prone position, mandibular distraction, tongue-lip adhesion. Surgical sequencing.
articles.content:
## Definition + triad

Pierre Robin sequence (PRS): triad of:
1. **Micrognathia** (small lower jaw)
2. **Glossoptosis** (tongue falls back blocking airway)
3. **Cleft palate** (often U-shaped)

*Sequence* (not syndrome) — chain of events: micrognathia → posterior tongue → cleft palate development.

## Etiology

### Isolated (50 %)
- Sporadic
- Mild upper airway obstruction

### Syndromic (50 %)
- **Stickler syndrome** (most common — 25 % PRS)
- **22q11.2 deletion / DiGeorge**
- **Treacher Collins**
- **Marshall syndrome**
- **Kabuki syndrome**
- **Diastrophic dysplasia**

## Presentation

### Severity grade
- **Mild:** intermittent stridor, snoring; no oxygenation issues
- **Moderate:** continuous stridor, retractions, mild SpO₂ drops
- **Severe:** apnea, severe desaturation, failure to thrive, requires intubation

### Clinical signs
- Inspiratory stridor (especially supine)
- Tongue falling backward visible на mouth open
- Feeding difficulty (poor seal, fatigue)
- Apnea / cyanosis
- Failure to thrive

## Workup

### Initial
- **CBC, blood gas**
- **CXR**
- **ENT consultation**
- **Polysomnography (PSG)** — gold standard severity
- **Genetics evaluation** (Stickler? 22q11?)
- **Eye exam** (Stickler retinal detachment risk)
- **Cardiac echo** (если syndromic)
- **Hearing screen**

## Treatment hierarchy

### Conservative (mild-moderate)
- **Prone or lateral positioning** (most basic — 80 % mild PRS resolved by 6-12 мес)
- **Speech therapy / lactation** support feeding
- **Specialized bottles** (Haberman, Pigeon) для cleft palate
- **NG / OG tube** если poor PO intake
- **Monitoring** SpO₂, weight, growth
- **Avoid supine sleep** (positional asphyxia)

### Mid-tier (moderate-severe)
- **NPCPAP** (nasopharyngeal CPAP)
- **High-flow nasal cannula**
- **Intubation** + временная MV если severe obstruction

### Surgical options

#### Tongue-lip adhesion (TLA)
- Sutures tongue dorsum к lower lip
- Anterior tongue pull, prevents glossoptosis
- Older technique (1970s-1990s)
- Less common now (mandibular distraction preferred)

#### Mandibular distraction osteogenesis (MDO) — preferred
- Surgical osteotomy + external/internal distractor
- Gradual extension 1 mm/d × 14-21 d → consolidation 4-6 нед
- Typically performed 1-3 мес возраста (after weight gain)
- 80-90 % avoids tracheostomy
- Long-term mandibular growth concerns

#### Tracheostomy (last-resort)
- Severe obstruction unresponsive к above
- Decannulation typically 1-3 yr возраста
- Reserve для most severe cases

### Cleft palate repair
- Typically 9-18 мес возраста
- Earlier (3-6 мес) controversial (better speech, less midface growth)

## Long-term outcomes

- Mandibular catch-up growth по 6-12 мес возраста
- Most achieve adequate airway без tracheostomy
- Speech / language therapy crucial
- Hearing concerns (middle ear effusion с cleft palate — myringotomy tubes)
- Stickler — annual ophthalmology (retinal detachment screening)

articles.summary: Generalized fetal edema. Causes: cardiac, anemia, infection, chromosomal. Pre-emptive intubation, drainage effusions, transfusion, treat underlying.
articles.content:
## Definition

Hydrops fetalis = abnormal fluid accumulation в ≥ 2 fetal compartments:
- Skin edema (≥ 5 mm)
- Pleural effusion
- Pericardial effusion
- Ascites
- Polyhydramnios (often associated)

## Categories

### 1. Immune hydrops (10 % cases — declining)
- Rh isoimmunization severe (anti-D, anti-Kell)
- ABO incompatibility severe (rare)
- Treatment with anti-D RhIG prophylaxis dramatically reduced

### 2. Non-immune hydrops (NIHF — 90 % cases)

#### Cardiac (15-25 %)
- Structural CHD (severe)
- Arrhythmias (SVT, complete heart block)
- Cardiomyopathies

#### Hematological (10-20 %)
- Anemia: parvovirus B19, α-thalassemia (Hb Bart's)
- Twin-twin transfusion (recipient — congestive HF)
- Maternal-fetal hemorrhage

#### Infection (5-10 %)
- TORCH (parvovirus B19 most common, CMV, syphilis)
- Coxsackievirus, adenovirus

#### Chromosomal (10-15 %)
- Turner syndrome (Y0/X0 → cystic hygroma)
- Trisomy 21
- Trisomy 18
- 45,XX/Y0

#### Lymphatic (5-10 %)
- Cystic hygroma
- Congenital chylothorax
- Lymphangiectasia

#### Pulmonary (5 %)
- Congenital pulmonary airway malformation (CPAM)
- Bronchopulmonary sequestration
- Diaphragmatic hernia

#### Metabolic (1-2 %)
- Lysosomal storage disorders (rare)

#### Idiopathic (15-30 %) — после workup

## Antenatal management

- **Detailed US + fetal echo** — etiology
- **MCA Doppler PSV** — fetal anemia screening
- **Karyotype + microarray** — chromosomal
- **TORCH titers maternal**
- **Hb electrophoresis maternal** — α-thalassemia
- **Antibody screen + DAT** — immune
- **Intrauterine transfusion (IUT)** при anemia
- **Fetoscopic laser** при TTTS
- **Fetal arrhythmia treatment** (amiodarone, flecainide через мать)
- **Delivery в специализированном center** с NICU + ECMO

## Postnatal management — emergency

### Delivery room
- **Pre-emptive intubation + MV** (poor lung compliance + chest effusion)
- **NG decompression** (gastric distention)
- **Drain effusions** при tampon/respiratory compromise:
  - Thoracocentesis (pleural effusion)
  - Paracentesis (ascites)
  - Pericardiocentesis (rare — tamponade)
- **Avoid excessive PIP** (rigid lungs — barotrauma risk)
- **HFOV** часто preferred
- **iNO** для severe PPHN

### Initial NICU
- **Vascular access** (UVC + UAC immediately)
- **PRBC transfusion** 10-20 мл/кг (uncrossmatched O-negative if severe anemia)
  - Goal Hb 120-150 g/L
- **Volume management** carefully:
  - Hypotension common (cardiac dysfunction + capillary leak)
  - Inotropes early (dopamine, epinephrine)
  - Avoid massive fluid resuscitation (worsens edema)
- **Diuretics later** (furosemide) once stable
- **DVET** (double volume exchange) при severe Rh isoimmunization
- **IVIG** 1 г/кг при immune hydrops

### Specific treatments
- **Phototherapy** (if hyperbilirubinemia)
- **TPN** (NPO initial, slow trophic feeds)
- **Empiric ABX** (cover possible infection)
- **Antiviral** (acyclovir) если HSV или severe parvovirus suspect
- **Surgery** для CDH, CPAM resection (later когда stable)

## Outcomes

### Mortality
- **Antenatal hydrops + survival к delivery:** 50-60 %
- **Postnatal hydrops requiring NICU:** 25-50 % survive к discharge
- Specific etiology determines prognosis:
  - Cardiac: very high mortality
  - α-thalassemia: very high (~ 100 % without IUT)
  - Chylothorax: better (60-80 % survival)
  - Idiopathic: variable
